You can enjoy a suspenseful play. ·There are various zombies big and small, it's fun to target them with special attacks. ·Collect all the various weapons used in the FPS game and all the special weapons that match the zombie's worldview. ·Clear the movie-like stories, the various wave modes, and the zombie modes such as Infinite Mode to earn bonuses. ·Zombies are waiting on a wide variety of stages, including battles on the subway, schools, hospitals, companies, etc. ·When you completely clear certain missions during the story, you can play the hidden stages that are not visible on the map. ·Enjoy the satisfactory playtime, clear the last stage and survive, and the ending is waiting for you! What kind of ending is that?! Prologue Terry and his girlfriend Shelly currently work at an IT company. One day, they are invited to a friend's home whom they have been very close to while in college. On that day, mysterious accidents occurred : terrorist attacks and an aircraft crash by armed forces. After partying all night and watching sports on TV, Terry and Shelly left to go to bed first... Zombies, the mysterious creatures dead living, have appeared in our…

title: Sweet Bakery Tycoon
description: Start your baking career and prepare some delicious cakes for your clients, using a whole set of creams, fruits, and decorations. Test your skills on 60 diverse and increasingly difficult levels. Personalize your interior with countless upgrades. All of us have a magic place, where everyday troubles seem to disappear. Sweet Bakery Tycoon fulfills your fantasy of creating and managing a bakery of your dreams

title: Arcane Arts Academy
description: Welcome to the Arcane Arts Academy, home to a magical menagerie of wonders! Join Erika as she adjusts to her new life and takes on the unique struggles and challenges of everyday life as a magical college student. She’ll make new friends, and maybe even find love… but she may also find unexpected foes! Something sinister lurks in the shadows, seeking to control Erika’s magical abilities. Perhaps not all is as it seems after all!

title: Siebenstreich's Nerdventure
description: RPG group looking for hero to save Mirrormore realm. Benefits of the job include reasonable work hours, your own towel and a moderate chance of resurrection in the event of your untimely demise. Interested in the open hero position? Great! That completes the party for a nice game of D&D (“Dice & Doom”, that is): Henry He avoids eye contact like a pro, yet rarely holds back when speaking his mind. In this party he plays the vegan carnivorous plant Trudie, a skilled artisan. You yourself Naturally, the best player at the table and of course playing the hero of this epic tale: An awesomely hip tailor and possible savior of worlds with the totally catchy nickname “Siebenstreich”. The GM The mastermind and ingenious storyteller of “Dice & Doom”. A creative opportunist with a passion for retro-gaming, pop culture and Blueberry Daiquiris (non-alcoholic). Siebenstreich’s Nerdventure is an upbeat 2D adventure game, pioneering the fantastic genre of pop culture fairytales. Look forward to witty dialog, puzzling puzzles (yep, sorry, pun intended), an amazing soundtrack as well as lovingly hand-drawn artwork and animations. While your party of unlikely heroes sets out to rescue a realm in distress, you’ll take cooking lessons with Mr. & Mr. Giant, outsmart a gang of flies and prove yourself in the improvised game shows hosted by the guerilla unicorn Sylvester Stallione. Among other things. And, rumor has it, the fabled throne Up'Zhykling might be up for grabs as well. Give a green thumbs up and save Mirrormore! Siebenstreich’s Nerdventure... …is a beautiful, hand-drawn…

title: Blind Descent
description: Blind Descent is a multiplayer open-world survival adventure game with up to 4 players set in the Martian underground.

title: MV Mazes
description: MV Mazes - A 2D game, where you need to find a way out of the mazes.

title: Updive
description: Updive is a colorful obstacle course game with constant moving, dodging and timer mechanics. Explore 10 courses with different levels of difficulty and types of obstacles.

title: Vincula
description: Discover, battle and explore this vast world of single player adventure. Make use of unique powers weapons and abilities and meet the charismatic characters that live in each biome. Will you be able to discover the great secret that Vincula holds?

title: Theo's World
description: Experience the adolescence of Theo, a 16-year-old who was rescued from a shipwreck and now has to survive on the island of Kraatoa. Theo earn money and resources to survive.

title: Town of the Dead Life
description: Town Of The Dead Life is an independent game with the background of eschatology. Players will play the role of one of the few surviving humans in the end of the world, surviving in difficult conditions and trying to change the fate of the world.

title: Zombie Simulator
description: A Huge Wave of Zombies Are Coming! Control hundreds of swarming zombies to conquer the entire city!

title: Stardiver
description:
Stardiver is a sci-fi, single-player, action-adventure game where you pilot a ship, fight enemies, and slay Bosses. The game takes place entirely underwater.

Stardiver will take you to an unknown world in which you’ll experience exciting fights, and discover new species and places. And you’ll take care of resources supply, crafting items in your base, and developing your own ship.

title: Legendary Journeys
description: Create your party of adventurers and set out on a quest to free an old man's magically imprisoned son. Journey the lands of Farmoor in search of the four artifacts needed to reform The Eye of Baal. Not all that live in Farmoor sees this as a good thing.

title: Cookie Store
description: Running a cafe is not an easy job. Especially when you're not making profits. Comedy, romance, friendship, and business combine in this unique Visual Novel!

title: The Build and Race Hotrod Game
description: Build and race a hotrod car.First you pick up parts from a waiting train using a truck and fork lift.Assemble car in a workshop using a crain Drive to the raceway with your hotrod.The russian mafia will try to stop you from entering a race.Race against other cars in a very demandig 5 lap race.

title: Whisperwind
description: Whisperwind is a short psychological horror experience featuring puzzles, multiple endings, creepy ambience and deep storytelling.

title: Wake Out of Twilight
description: In the future, life can't get any easier. Anybody can now live the life of their dreams with no effort. However, the price for this is more than anybody agreed too. Go on a journey to help society free themselves from the nightmare.

title: Zeko
description: A calm and cute original puzzle game. Clear stages to unlock the next one. Each stage has its own challenge.

title: Noctambulant
description: Noctambulant is a hand-drawn 2D survival and psychological horror game. Renee moves in with her grandmother after the passing of her parents in a tragic accident. Walk with Renee and unfold the terrifying mystery as to why she was made to go to bed early every night.

title: Box Factory
description: Box Factory is an isometric puzzle game where the player needs to push boxes on the right tiles in full 3D and teleports.

title: No Cure
description: Step into the shoes of Jon. A police officer in 1984 at the beginning of a zombie outbreak. An adventurer found a mysterious worm that once brought to the city creates a flood of zombies and could lead to the end of the world. You must explore the city, find health and guns to survive.

title: At the Downstairs
description: What, you can easily pass all the obstacles you face? So, are you our last hope? So, do you want some absurdity? And are you doing all this to beat the ZUMBEKUKKA at downstairs? Dude, you are really brave!

title: Cyberpunk SFX
description: What can be more spectacular than a girl armed with rockets and a sense of humor? Yes, she is about to start solving the problems of the 21st century. And if you want to make sure she doesn’t create a few new ones, you’ll have to show her the way.

title: Fire Safety Lab VR
description: Learn how to use fire extinguishers of different types, how to protect yourself from smoke and high temperatures, what to do in the event of a fire alarm and how to find an emergency exit from the building. Fire Safety Lab VR gives you an immersive experience of being in emergency.

title: Freedom: How I Escaped
description: This is your chance. The time has come to put oppression in your past. The escape plan is ready, but you must avoid all surveillance and run undetected. Its time to make your own path. To make your own future. Its now or never.

title: Pretty Girls Klondike Solitaire
description: Let's play some Klondike "Solitaire" with the girls from the "Pretty Girls" series! Play against 10 Pretty Girls each stage and dress them up in different outfits! Clear Solitaire and earn new costumes!

title: Cinnamon fight
description: Cinnamon fight is a multiplayer game, where you can fight up to three enemies. They can be your friends or random people. This game consists of more than 500 levels, more than 40 weapons and lots of obstacles which are going to have masive impact on your gameplay strategy

title: FM
description: A mysterious radio announcer describes a recent murder-suicide as the unknown protagonist navigates through an ever-shifting environment.

title: Lilith Odyssey
description: The Great Nacho Wars have ended. A corrupt galactic government saps life and resources from the many war-weary planets it controls. Your alien family risks everything across an open-world galactic odyssey to find a mysterious land of new beginnings. And they’re all aware of their simulated nature.

title: Cyber Psychosis
description: Cyber Psychosis is a pseudo-3D dynamic first-person shooter in a cyberpunk setting with a lot of enemies, blood and drive

title: Altwaldheim: Town in Turmoil
description: Be the mayor of this great old town! Construct buildings, recruit soldiers and send them to war. Will you be able to keep Altwaldheim safe?

title: Across the demon realm 2
description: A retro brutal-horror platformer in pixel-art!

title: The Medic
description: The Medic. The first Coronavirus-themed topdown/platformer published on Steam. Can you beat the anti-vaxxers and the virus to save the Earth?

title: Splash Cars
description: Paint the world a better place, one neighborhood at a time.

title: The Maze: Humanity
description: An immersive multiplayer VR RPG filled with adventure and heart pounding action. A dynamic experience in an apocalyptic realm. Will you enter The Maze to defend humanity?

title: Alek
description: Post-soviet Russia, Tyumen in 1995. Alexey Smirnov, a local shot-caller, nicknamed 'Alek' found out about the death of his friends and swore to avenge. The bloody war started between the gangs of the city. However, a true enemy turned out not to be common gangsters, but men much scarier

title: Dumpy & Bumpy
description: A retro styled character puzzle game with couch co-op and 80 puzzles to solve!

title: Touhou Gensokyo Visitor
description: Walking through the forest, Reimu meets a stranger in the forest, now she needs to understand where he came from, and how he got through the barrier.

title: Darkness Eternal
description: A button-based top-down tower defense game that uses multiple mechanics for the player to enhance and defeat enemies with. There are 3 different towers the player unlocks by completing levels. Each one has a different purpose, range, damage, and rate of fire as the primary mechanics.

title: The Phantom Fellows
description: The Phantom Fellows is about two best friends who start a paranormal investigation business together, since one of them is already dead.

title: Distorted
description: The psychological horror Distorted, plays inside the head of Morgan Tyler, a mentally ill man, whose vision had been corrupted.

title: Bounty Brawl
description: Play as a bounty hunter. Hunt your most wanted targets through the eye-catching nostalgic worlds. Gather a team of friends and work together to defeat Criminal Bosses. And most importantly, TRUST NO ONE!

title: MultiMind Challengers
description: MultiMind Challengers is a 2D soulslike action RPG with a unique system and universe. Adapt and fight to survive in the biosphere turned into a multiminded invasion.

title: Endgame: Road to Salvation
description: A high-octane road trip through a besieged world during a demon-infested zombie apocalypse. Rescue survivors, form a caravan, call in various support drops or air strikes, loot random structures for supplies or craft them yourself, modify common vehicles into post-apocalyptic machines of war.

title: MessiahEnd Refrain
description: This is an action game where a cute girl explores the stage!

title: Dead Man's Rest
description: A Wild West BxB story of love, murder, and revenge. Play as Lee "Blackjack" McCarthy on his hunt for the elusive Wild Bill—until a mysterious killing shatters all his plans.

title: Aster fpv
description: Aster fpv is a racing and shooting drone simulator, players can compete in races or shoot themselves with a rocket launcher or submachine gun, or simply train to fly an fpv drone

title: Horror Bar VR
description: Horror Bar is an incredibly engaging Zombie Bar simulator where you can take on the role of bartender and serve your scarily nice customers multiple crazy dishes and drinks.

title: I x She Tell
description: At long last - we, the student council, have won you your freedom to love! The moment I declare these words, my classmates come surging forward, surrounding me in a circle of cheers that echo across the entire campus.

title: Sylphy and the Sleepless Island
description: One night while on a job, a small-time thief named Sylphy overhears a rumor about a powerful artifact called the Orb of the Abyss. Hearing that it will be vulnerable, she sets sail for the island.

title: Rise of the samurai in VR
description: During the Warring States Period in Japan, the Tokugawa Shogunate levied heavily and aggressively. So a young Ronin fled Kyoto, and came to North China.

title: Godsbane
description: Craft explosive combos of units and powers to use in head-to-head auto battler combat against players worldwide. Outplay your opponent with strategic maneuvers and watch the battle unfold on a tabletop arena. Win matches to climb the ranks and become Godlike in this lunchtime eSport!

title: She Turned Me Into a Newt!
description: You've been turned into a newt by a necromantress! Your task is to find the way to turn back.

title: Yakuza Cats
description: Yakuza Cats is a graphic adventure set in a 100% feline Tokyo. This original world mixes Ukiyo-e art with Gen Z aesthetics. It is a coming of age story that puts the player through different ethical choices while tackling themes such as identity and prejudice.

title: Colorful Trip
description: Sailing in the colorful world Avoid attacks or use the power of color to destroy them Fight for higher scores on endless voyages

title: Hyper Psychic Gauntlets
description: You uncover an ancient artifact that grants you telekinetic powers, and in doing so awaken its guardians to prove your worth as its wielder. Smash your way through your enemies as you uncover the hidden powers of your artifact.

title: Performer
description: Performer is a game with fun puzzles. Test your logic and ingenuity in different locations of the world as a mercenary who has to eliminate goals or steal secret developments.

title: Blocks!: Hammer of the Scots
description: Hammer of the Scots brings both the rebellion of the Braveheart, William Wallace, and the uprising of Robert the Bruce, the Bandit King, to life. As English, you seek to pacify Scotland by controlling all important nobles. The Scots also seeks their allegiance to support the struggle for freedom.

title: Playing God
description: Speedrun your way across the nine circles of hell through 100 levels in this ultra fast-paced precision platformer, rebelling against the mysterious entity playing god.

title: Skythrone
description: SkyThrone is a vertical shooter in which you have to defend the Earth from invading space invaders. You are a sexy girl commander who, from childhood, learned to achieve her goal at any cost. This skill came in handy when entering the military and subsequent promotion.

title: The Choice of Life: Middle Ages 2
description: Explore your kingdom and rule wisely in the card game - The Choice of Life: Middle Ages 2

title: Winter Sleigh
description: Do you miss REAL winters with REAL SNOW? Do you want to slide down hills ON A SLEIGH?! Well, who wouldn't! Join the fun in challenging tracks (or make your own) on shiny hills and puffy snowbanks of Winter Sleigh!

title: Avanti: The Joy of Driving
description: Drive different cars on different locations in first person driver view only. Complete quests like getting a good racetime or for example slalom driving to unlock the next racetrack. Or just drive for relaxing.

title: The Ways of Uron
description: The Ways of Uron is a top-down Action-Adventure RPG in a fantasy setting. Travel to exotic lands to discover relics, recruit new friends, and solve the mystery of Garen's past.

title: The Dark Method
description: The Dark Method is a single player, story-driven VR game where the player gets to explore creepy/scary environments, solve classic adventure/survival horror game style puzzles, and battle monsters along the way.

title: TaoYaoTa
description: The ancient land was in turmoil, and the root of all this was because of the evil tower. In order to save the world, countless monks decided to go down the mountain and flatten the pagoda named "Taoyao", and return a jade to the world. And you are the one with the most potential.

title: Kill the Pineapple
description: Kill the Pineapple is a trippy Third Person Shooter in a psychedelic dream-world.

title: I_Darkness
description: Puzzle game in an escape room scenario created using Unreal Engine 4.

title: Chessers
description: Chessers is a bastardized hybrid of Chess and Checkers! Do you have what it takes to become the next Chessers grandmaestro?

title: Apostle 3D
description: Apostle 3D is a throwback to retro shooters of the 90s, Fight your way through the dead, demons , religious fanatics and time to take revenge on those who took your life. Stop the demonic invasion and rest in peace. Controls: WASD Top Number keys: Weapon Switch Mouse

title: Christmas Day
description: Christmas Day is a one - day simulator. Just enjoy the atmosphere of Christmas. It's not a game, it's just one room filled with festive comfort and warmth.

title: Stop and Move
description: Pay attention and stop at the right time when rolling through the levels!

title: Chickamauga Battles
description: Refight one of the most significant battles of the American Civil War 'the Battle of Chickamauga'.

title: Magnum Opus
description: Join Magnum Opus the online social multiplayer game and hang out with friends from all around the world! Play multiplayer minigames, meet new people or explore several planets in the vast universe of the metaverse.

title: LuvSic
description: One day you accepted a special job: make friends with girls living on this street, open their hearts to tell you their love stories. You will get paid for the writing of these stories...

title: Cats In Space
description: Cats In Space is adventure game with a storyline. In game you are taking control of two cats. Also you need to move without gravitation. You will have to fight against aliens, avoid traps and collect collectibles.

title: Fox Girls Never Play Dirty
description: A classic style turn-based RPG. While traveling in the country of Stivale, Ryuunosuke bumps into a fox girl named Selena. Before long, he's brawling with the police, and he gets wrapped up in a movement to reform the country.

title: Foglight
description: Survive high risk gameplay as you are pursued by a terrifying monstrosity throughout a perilous open environment. You work to uncover secrets and escape the growing nightmare threatening your life!

title: Infinite Dimensions
description: A Japanese strategy adventure game Operate a protagonist, match lineup, equipment, skills, etc. to form a combat team Instant combat system, rougelike Plot Role development Sword and Magic

title: AOD: Art of Defense
description: AOD is a new gameplay in the traditional tower defence genre. You must protect your base from waves of approaching enemies. Build and improve your towers and units and destroy your enemies in any way you can. Don't be weak, destroy them all, show who's in charge!

title: MiniStrike
description: A shoot’em up game with bite-size levels.

title: Lavalamp
description: 3D first-person walking simulator with a side of exploration/interaction with the environment. The game tells the story of the Space Lemmings from Space who, after running many experiments with breakfast alphabet and the space-time continuum, got blocked between dimensions (or something).

title: Velocity Noodle
description: Jump, slide and teleport to deliver Noodles in this fast-paced 2D platformer. Discover routes, moves and dodge traps to beat record times. Add to your Wishlist today!

title: Divine Stone
description: Divine Stone is a 2D platformer puzzle game in which you have to find answers to riddles that will definitely make you brainwash. In addition, time constraints and a variety of opponents will become an obstacle on your way.

title: Attack of the Karens
description: Attack of the Karens is a roguelite bullet hell shoot 'em up that focuses on difficult multi-phased boss fights, all against the backdrop of the "Karen" meme. Piloting the Manager X-15, embark on a mission to rid the world of evil cyborg Karens and save your city from entitlement forever!

title: Grow Defense
description: Upgrade your Castle and Unlock new tiers of Skills and Weapons to Defend vs Monsters and Bosses across VARIOUS ZONES! Find Rare ITEMS dropped from monsters and bosses and upgrade them to their full potential! Defeat RAID Mega-Bosses to find LEGENDARY items!

"There have to be 9 people offering to the Devil every year on the full moon night. If anyone survives 3 days after being offered to the Devil, the Devil will be back to this world. The Devil will grant this world happiness and freedom.

title: Afterlife: The Second Dimension
description:
A schoolgirl named Yuna finds herself alone in her classroom, without knowing what happened before. After a while, she meets his best friend Kazuki and will discover that creatures appeared from nowhere and tried to kill them. Together, they'll have to figure out what's going on and pass through this nightmare.

What is happening in this town?

title: Chikoku no Mokushiroku
description: Chikoku no Mokushiroku is a single player adventure RPG about a man who's locked in his house and can't get out.

title: Matryona no Yuube
description: Matryona is a pretty, adorable girl. That’s what her mother tells her, what her father tells her. She is the ideal daughter that anyone could wish for… But is the reality of the situation truly as sweet as it seems? As they say, everyone has their secrets…

title: Ichiro Shounen Kitan
description: Ichiro is a boy interested in the paranormal. One day while he was playing kokkuri-san, he annoys the seven mysteries of his school. These spirits prevent Ichiro and his friend from leaving the school, so he must face each of them to get out.

title: Girls' Last Tour: Book Burning Simulator
description: Get Yuuri to burn as many books as possible without the sleepy Chito noticing!

title: Nightmare of the Snow
description: On a very snowy and dark morning, Yuuki Shinozaki, a shy middle schooler, was preparing for her trip to a farewell party of her school...but an unfortunate tragedy happened. When Yuuki was helping her friend, Taiga, to look for his lost handphone, she was taken mysteriously to a lost, dark dimension where a big, mysterious mansion existed. Yuuki didn't know...that this is all just the beginning of her NIGHTMAREs in THE SNOWy and freezing night...

title: Table Tennis
description:
Play this classic table tennis game against your friends, family or the the smart the Ai player anytime.

Matches are randomly hosted in 8 different locations around a school.

Beat the toughest opponent with the perfect angle shot by slicing the ball and moving in the other direction as fast as you can.

The Ai player has 3 levels of skill, from easy to hard, however the real challenge may be against your human opponents, either way winning won't come easy.

title: Kyouren no Utage
description:
A boy wakes up in the dark, cold cell after seeing the death of his family.
What is this place, why is he here?
While he tries to find the way out of this place, he experiences pieces of memories, flashbacks to solve the mystery of his abduction as well as someone else past...

Take the role of a boy, Takuma, and explore this eerie place, find missing pieces of memories to solve and escape while running away from insane creatures that lurks about the place...

title: Above Snakes
description: Piece by piece, create your own world and survive in this Wild West-inspired survival RPG. Craft, farm, hunt, build your base, and fight in order to stay alive.

title: Star Point Explorer
description:
A minimalist space arcade game.

You ride a planet to discover new colorful places in space full of constellations.
The goal is to reach the finish quickly without falling out of constellations and collect as many stars as possible.
You can use collected stars to unlock new planets.

title: Crysis Remastered Trilogy
description: The classic first person shooter from Crytek is back with the action-packed gameplay, sandbox world, and thrilling epic battles you loved the first time around – now with remastered graphics optimized for a new generation of hardware.

title: DreamHack Beyond
description:
Welcome to DreamHack Beyond, an at-home, all-digital free interactive experience showcasing the best of DreamHack. Players can dive into the story of the mystical Sleepers by creating their own characters, completing the game’s narrative, looking for side quests and building up their XP, farming for items like Cheer Gear, and more! Want to skip the game and get right to the booth you want? No problem!

DreamHack Beyond can be enjoyed anyway you like. With areas dedicated to game demos, cosplay, tournaments, and more, DreamHack is looking to go BEYOND the creative edge and create a one-of-a-kind online multiplayer experience. Scroll down to read more and join our community pages below for more updates.

title: Migawari Shoujo
description: Hitomi is a little girl who discovers that one of her relatives choose to make her a sacrifice to die in her place. A shinigami decides give Hitomi a chance at life. To save herself, she must discover who is the person who wanted to sacrifice her and the one who was really destined to die.

title: Doubutsu-tachi no Mori
description: You live in a house in the forest with your parents, one day walking back from collecting herbal plants you meet across a sinister crow that’s the likely case of an upcoming nightmare. The forest itself from here on out being the center stage of this scenario, where we as the protagonist must find a means to escape this nightmare.

title: Shiro no Noroi
description: Mashiro is a simple girl with typical father occupied by his work, so it ends up living in her grandmother’s house. After months of living with her ​​grandmother, Shiro (Mashiro) contacts her father asking him to visit so you can both enjoy the festival to be in place. However, the day of the festival, while waiting for her father Shiro, they begin to appear spirits. Being attacked by such spirits Shiro is saved by Hachi, who tells her that these spirits are actually “Curses” and that some of these souls stole his 7 souls. If not recovered quickly, she will die.

title: Shuutai Headless
description: Erina is a girl who appears in a mysterious place that seems to be an old prison. When she explores the place, she encounters the mysterious character known as the Red Witch, she warns her that place is full of evilness and prisoners who seek for revenge. Erina must find the way to escape from that place without being caught by the prisoners.

title: Space Bandit
description: A rogue-lite top down shooter with crazy firefights and clever AI.

title: Blood Knot
description: Blood Knot is a 2D Side-View RPG where estranged father and daughter must work together in order to survive in the wilderness of 19th century Brazil, while they search for a treasure they hope will change their lives.

title: Yummy Nuts
description: Cut the ropes, collect the nuts, have fun!

title: Inferno: Beyond the 7th Circle
description: Grid-Based First Person Dungeon Crawler with survival elements. It's inspired by classic cRPG from the 90s. An old-school game for hardcore players.

title: Adorable Witch
description: This is a casual strategy game, how to avoid the devil and guide the direction of the water droplets is the key to clear the game.

title: Reforged TD
description: Reforged Tower Defense is a genre mix of tower defense and RPG where you can choose from a variety of skills, towers and units. You can decide whether you want to play a round with your friends or force the rankings.

title: Nkodice
description: NKODICE is an adaptation of a traditional Japanese dice game, which is called Chinchirorin, developed by KSYM in Japan.

title: A Sky Full of Stars Interstellar Focus
description: The FD to the events of the original Miagete Goran, Yozora Hoshi wo.

title: Fistful of Nothing
description: You are stuck in a building with no exit, Surrounded by armed gunmen and elevators that choose to not work properly. Use an empty gun and your wits to trick your way to safety to LIVE to see another day!

title: Half-Life: Dark Matter
description: An upcoming Total Conversion for Half-Life that puts you in the perspective of a Black Operations Assassin, Kovac.

title: Azure Sheep
description: Azure Sheep is a single player mod for Half-Life. The player is one of the Barney guards that is on post in one of the entrances of the Black Mesa facility When the chaos starts you realize that Kate, your college, code name 'Azure Sheep' is in the complex and in big dangers. You decide to rescue her...

title: Uktena
description: Hunt and topple Gargantuans to keep the enemy at bay in this atmospheric Titan-Rush Game!

title: Edge of Dead: Under a Uranium Sky
description: Edge Of Dead is an action roguelike game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Use shotguns, power saws, axes, hand grenades, cybernetic implants, and more to battle your way across the scorched landscape.

title: Dark Side of War
description: Dark Side of War - is a classic 3D shooter with hardcore elements where you are a single soldier fighting in the enemy rear.

title: Minion Masters: Nightmares
description:
As Mar’Dred, the Prince of Nightmares emerges from the void, he brings his demonic legions with him into our world to seed chaos...

The Nightmares Faction Box will provide you with Voidborne trickery you’ll need to lay waste to those foolish enough to oppose you. Containing +300% value of Voidborne cards, including the sneaky Mal’Shar and 2 exclusive Voidborne cosmetics.

Includes:
- 3x Mal’Shar Shadowfork (Legendary!)
- 5x Demon Warrior (Supreme)
- 20x Shadow Whelp
- 50x Dragon Ball
- 50x Boomer
- 5x Power Tokens
- 1x Legendary Emote - Animated!
- 1x Supreme Avatar

Surprise your opponents with the trickery of the Voidborne. Use your invisible Shadow Whelp to sneak past enemy lines and damage the enemy Master to enable Voidborne Wound, which creates bonuses for many Voidborne cards, such as the Boomer. Or you can just toss a dragon over in your enemy’s arena with Dragon Ball. Win the game by creating an invisible army with Mal’Shar, or summon Demon Warrior enough times to have her triple in size!

title: Devil Engine: Ignition
description: Heat up Devil Engine with Ignition! Featuring 6 new stages, a new ship and an all-star Arranged soundtrack, Devil Engine Ignition nearly doubles the amount of content in Devil Engine!

title: Heli Golf
description: This is a very different kind of golf game, you can control a helicopter to play golf, instead of using the pole, and you can fly straight to the hole and drop the ball

description: Simple and easy to play player poker by yourself. The story mode is just like a novel game. You'll enjoy chatting with her and trying the challenges that she gives you.

title: Blacksmith Bay
description: Start the smithing shop of your dreams in Blacksmith Bay. Craft weapons to seek fortune and glory in the sleepy town of Port Pleasant. Decorate your shop to attract customers, complete commissions, and unravel the secrets of the Corbots!

title: Bunny's Maze
description: Bunny's Maze is a colorful 3D Puzzle game, navigate two little rabbits and move the walls to create a path. Go through the maze and collect all the hidden carrots. Enjoy this cute and relaxing game for all ages.

title: The Last Ones Left
description: "The LastOnesLeft" is a first-person survival horror game where the player finds themselves in an abandoned village overrun by zombies. Uncover the truth about what happened by finding mysterious letters from an unknown source.

title: Ghost Stories 2
description: This is an exciting adventure in an abandoned house in which you are left alone with ghosts and their heavy stories.

title: Unity of Command II: Barbarossa
description: In this DLC, you command Axis forces during Operation Barbarossa, from their summer of roaring victories to the painful halt at the gates of Moscow in the winter of 1941/42.

title: Bragger's Run
description: A Procedurally Generated Rogue-Lite Action Game: Bragger's Run takes you on a death race across a hostile continent where you'll collect treasures and trophies from your kills. Play as the Gunslinger, the Duelist, or the Wizard and see if you have what it takes. Can you make The Run?

title: A Fox and His Robot
description: Become a fox and escape the grip of powerful Artificial Intelligences in a 2D action-platformer. A young fox and his robot search for meaning in a beautiful yet dangerous world.

title: The Last Sunshine: Rekindled
description: The Last Sunshine: Rekindled is a rogue-lite & schmup hybrid. Level up your stars, earn a variety of skills, then mix and match them with your customized stats to dispatch droves of dark aggressive enemies. Will light win against the darkness? It's the end of the universe!

title: Death Upon Us
description: Death Upon Us, is a game in which you will use your arsenal of guns to pull off cunning, exciting, and adrenaline pumping maneuvers to conquer levels in this game. Watch as your skills take you from killing a small horde of zombies in the School Yard to killing an abundance of zombies in the Temple.

title: Manufactoria 2022
description: Manufactoria 2022 is a constructive puzzle game about pushing robots around.

title: Artemishea
description: Step into a unforgiving world of danger and try to survive as you compete among other players to stay alive, Play as a animal and take down large prey as you progress along in your life. Hunt, Survive and Thrive in this land.

description: Mystic Ruin: A New Dawn follows the protagonist Faust and the remainder of his crew after crash landing on a strange new world. Slay beasts, gather treasure, and most importantly learn the secrets of this strange new land throughout your adventure.

title: Power Ball 2021
description: Power Ball 2021 is here to provide block busting, ball bouncing, gun shooting action for 1 or 2 players. Inspired by great bat and ball games of the past with powerups thrown in to help you defeat the increasingly challenging levels.

title: Masquerade of Miasma
description: A bubble pop style game set during a Medieval plague, where proper sanitation, social distancing and toilet paper are key. Journey through this beautiful Medieval community, joined by other medical professionals, to save your home.

title: Skinwalkers
description: A Horror Adventure where YOU dictate the ending.

description: A mysterious forest with strange happenings... murderous torment... alone in the silent forest? precision platformer game with puzzle elements.

description: Mission: In Boxes, as a spy agent, uses clever use of spy gadgets to advance through various gimmick stages. It is a puzzle escape game in VR space aiming at obtaining the target. Enjoy a new sense of VR puzzle escape game!

description: This is Wild World, there is danger at every step.

description: Explore the enigmatic world of Isola Benedicta. Fight dangerous monsters, solve quests, and advance your skills in this fantasy open-world RPG full of charm and adventure.

description: Red ball escape is a simple puzzle platformer game with 100 Levels to complete and simple controls which ends up in simply fun!

title: Xombee
description: First Person Zombie Shooter

description: Bring Honey Home is a block filling puzzle game. To complete a level you need to drag pieces to the gameboard and fill up the whole grid. It comes with 4 difficulties ranging from Beginner to Expert and there are 240 levels in total. Features : - Different diffifulties - 240 levels - Sweet art design

title: Protoplasm Mutiny
description: When the defense collapses, the rebels invade the base and escape has become the only choice. Take the people you care about and get out of the siege.

description: Join the adventure of Jeff the F-16 pilot! Jeff-16 is a fun and challenging obstacle course shooter game where you attempt to fly perfectly through golden rings.You will fly across cities and mountains in an attempts to destroy the evil army who attacked your beloved city.

title: Minotaur Maze
description: Minotaur Maze is a simple action puzzle game about navigating a maze and avoiding a monster. Somewhere out there lurking, The Minotaur is honing in on your location and hunting you down! With each new level, the difficulty increases because the maze gets larger and the Minotaur gets faster.

title: Ghost College
description: An average college girl takes an elective class and everything is different. Death, spooky, enveloped her, uncovering the truth, looking for clues, making the right choice was the only way.

title: Black Smith 3
description: You are a blacksmith in a small rural village. You steadfastly earn your living by hammering out products daily, but at night, you take your earnings and go to town to seek out innocent and cute girls. Continue improving your experience and skills, so that you can raise the price of your products.

title: Desolatium
description:
Dive into the well-known Myths of Lovecraft in a whole new way with this immersive, first-person, Point & Click, Graphic Adventure, with a taste of Survival Horror.

You will have to investigate mysterious events in order to find who is hiding behind all of the madness. But you may find something you were not looking for, since discovering what is happening will take you into a world of darkness, terror, and insanity, this is, a desolated world.

Explore a new lovecraftian adventure. Be part, like never before, of an exciting mystery based on Lovecraft’s Mythos, full of puzzles, sects, and primordial deities.

title: Freelance Trucker: Insurance Fraud Edition
description: Driving a big rig in a rigged economy has its risks, but that's why you have insurance.

title: Prison Girl
description: The girl Mei is framed to kill, become the inmate of X prison. The player plays a girl in the prison to survive and eventually try to escape the prison.

description: Clicking has never been more fun with Fruit Clicker! Low on space? Bored? Then Fruit Clicker is the right game for you! Click fruit and achievements which reveal the game's backstory. Buy upgrades to become an efficient clicker. Eat fruit all day long! Play Fruit Clicker now!

description: Story mode combines the reasoning murderer to get the favor of female characters Multiple endings, multiple branches Form a interactive Supernatural story, The zombie mode killing monsters, different plots.

title: Mahjong Gold 2: Pirates Island
description: Let sail from Port Royal on a ship called the Golden Hind and head for Hard Luck Island. Legend has it that untold treasures are hidden there.

description: Sir, welcome to the Advanced Surveillance Program. According to the Foreign Domain Surveillance Act signed by the Prime Minister, you will obtain the surveillance authority of KINGSBURY City. You can discover and eliminate threats by creating and deploying surveillance systems throughout the city.

title: Erotic Jigsaw Puzzle 2
description: Challenging 6 x 6 jigsaw puzzle featuring hardcore sex scenes by Lolita LineArt, on a smooth luxury graphical background.

title: Capcom Arcade Stadium: Dynasty Wars
description: Add Dynasty Wars to your Capcom Arcade Stadium game line-up! It's the very end of the Han Dynasty. The Yellow Turban Rebellion has thrown China into turmoil, and the warlord Dong Zhuo threatens the imperial throne itself. In the face of destruction, four men band together, ready to fight to preserve the dynasty!

title: Capcom Arcade Stadium: Tatakai no Banka
description: Add Tatakai no Banka to your Capcom Arcade Stadium game line-up! The spirits of demonic warlords have taken over the world. You alone can stand against the forces of evil! Use your mastery of the martial arts to defeat the demonic armies!

title: Capcom Arcade Stadium: Mega Twins
description: Add Mega Twins to your Capcom Arcade Stadium game line-up! Fifteen years have passed since the peaceful utopia of Alurea was destroyed by monsters. The twin sons of the king have grown into strong young men.

title: Azure
description: A final project of my college freshman year. Just jump and dash and have fun.

title: Nine Worlds
description: This is a ARPG game, at the same time contains some roguelike elements, players will freely choose to control a body, fight them in the world of monsters, in the world to find the artifact that can help you, defeat the island controller, and finally find the entrance to the next world.

title: Xtreme Typing
description: This fast-moving, action game will keep your fingers on the keyboard as you move your motorcycle across the desert and through the heart of the city. Type accurately and faster than your target words per minute and watch a motorcycle stunt fest!

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou - Tenkafubu Scenario
description: An additional playable scenario for the title "Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou." This scenario centers around Nobunaga's grand plan to unite the land, and the historical drama that it ignited.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou - Nagashinonotatakai Scenario
description: An additional playable scenario for the title "Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou." Following Shingen's death, Nobunaga senses an opportunity to strike at the Takeda clan. In this age of uncertainty, heroes are made and legends are born.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Taishi - The Dutiful Lord of Echigo Scenario
description: An additional scenario available for "Nobunaga's Ambition: Taishi." Harukage Nagao succeeded his father, Tamekage Nagao of Echigo, as leader of the Nagao clan. However, his weak nature soon had control passing to his younger brother Kagetora.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Taishi - The Battle of Nagashino Scenario
description: A great star falls. With the death of the head of the Takeda clan, it appeared the Takeda offensive was over. However, even without Shingen, the Takeda weren't finished. Katsuyori, the heir of the Tiger, continued to expand with the same momentum as his predecessor.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Taishi - The Battle of Okitanawate Scenario
description: An additional scenario available for "Nobunaga's Ambition: Taishi." Following the defeat of the Otomo by the Shimazu, the Ryuzoji clan began to build up their own forces. This left the battle for Kyushu between the Shimazu and Ryuzoji clans.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou with Power Up Kit - Shokutokudoumei Scenario
description: An additional playable scenario for the title "Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou with Power Up Kit". Relive the historical drama unfold towards unification in the footsteps of Nobunaga Oda and Ieyasu Tokugawa, the sworn allies from childhood.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou - Tennouzan Scenario
description: An additional playable scenario for the title "Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou." After the Incident at Honnoji, chaos reigns once more, and heroes from across the land vie for power.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou - Dokuganryutatsu Scenario
description: An additional playable scenario for the title "Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou." This scenario centers around the bold and ambitious One-Eyed Dragon, Masamune Date, and his heroic gamble to seize control of the land. This is a story of passion and unbridled ambition.

title: Rozalin and the Palace of Flowers
description: Rozalin and the Palace of Flowers is a yuri visual novel about love between three girls while fighting against a curse.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Taishi - Mount Tennozan Scenario
description: An additional scenario available for "Nobunaga's Ambition: Taishi." Who will gain control of the chaotic world that springs up after the death of Nobunaga Oda? Will it be Mitsuhide Akechi or Hideyoshi Hashiba? A battle for control of the land erupts in the vicinity of Mount Tennozan.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou with Power Up Kit - Gunshinkourinsu Scenario
description: Additional playable scenario for the title "Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou with Power Up Kit". Kagetora Uesugi, later known to become Kenshin Uesugi the God of War, arrives at a battle shattered Echigo. Relive the historical drama of the ambitious expedition the young hero sets out to.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou - Tetorigawa Scenario
description: An additional playable scenario for the title "Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou." Nobunaga Oda, in an attempt to seize control of the land, comes face to face with the honorable Kenshin Uesugi. This is the story of men who followed their ambitions to the bitter end.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Taishi - Birth of Nobunaga Scenario
description: An additional scenario available for "Nobunaga's Ambition: Taishi." ▼How to use To play, select "New Game." Then, from the scenario selection screen, select "Birth of Nobunaga."

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou - Shingenjouraku Scenario
description: An additional playable scenario for the title "Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou." The time has finally arrived for the Takeda Army, reputedly the strongest in the land, to march upon the capital. Shingen's illness has healed, and he is no longer uncertain of what he desires.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou - Itsukushima Scenario
description: An additional playable scenario for the title "Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou." This scenario centers around the great strategist Motonari Mori, and the time he made his move. This is the story of men who dreamed of conquest, and risked their lives.

title: Surabaya Inferno
description: Freedom or Death! Surabaya Inferno is a real-time tactics game based on the battle of Surabaya which occured at November 10th, 1945. Play as Surabayans fighting against the forces of Britain, Netherlands, and Japan in order to defend their independence in Indonesia!

title: Renegade: Arena Shooter
description: Renegade is a fast first person shooter inspired by many older shooters such as Doom, Aliens vs. Predator, Quake and many more!

title: Soulcaster
description:
Use skill and strategy to fight through hordes of monsters to discover secrets, collect treasure and buy powerful upgrades for your allies. Become the Soulcaster and restore peace to the land.

Soulcaster combines dungeon crawling and tower defense mechanics to provide an all new adventuring experience. Journey into perilous lands with no weapons and no magic, but with the ability to summon the spirits of three ancient warriors, each with unique combat skills. Think fast and set up your defenses, because the enemies are relentless!

description: Get your spaceship and embark on an amazing astral adventure of engaging puzzles into the final frontier. Overcome challenges and earn rewards that will let you discover more incredible puzzle planets in the farthest reaches of outer space.

He will send helicopters, tanks, planes, artillery barrages, and eventually grab his shotgun and come after you himself.

title: VR Walking Simulator
description: It is a VR Walking Simulator. Nothing more, nothing less. Explore beautiful scenes optimized for VR viewing, take pictures of the scenery, make a collage, and relax.

title: Towards the Stars
description: You are the captain of a mining ship watching your home world being destroyed by a large asteroid. Your only hope is to gather resources, create new technologies and set off on a long journey into the deep space to search of a new home.

title: Bubble Gun 3D
description: The most unique, addicting and satisfying shooting game so far!

title: Stray Kitten
description: Stray Kitten is a short 2D platformer with surviving and hardcore elements where it is described a story about one lost kitten Silver.

title: Rescue Rover Collection
description: This classic pair of whimsical and challenging grid-based action puzzle games are now available together in one package! Rescue your dog Rover from evil robots across two full games by solving fiendishly complex environmental puzzles to retrieve your beloved pup and make it safely back home.

title: Abstractanks
description: Abstractanks is an action-packed real-time-strategy game with an abstract theme. Play intense skirmishes with up to sixteen teams, where map-control, positioning, decision-making, speed and a little bit of luck are rewarded.

title: Algebra Ridge
description: Ready to save the world with the power of math? Find out in this unique story-driven adventure! In Algebra Ridge, you must stop Big Cheesy from stealing the Pencil of Knowledge!

title: Chasing the wind
description: Chasing the wind is a casual level game and parkour game, accompanied by laid-back music, constantly flight forward. Faced with various obstacles, you need to consider the way to pass the game skillfully or flexibly. Of course, smooth levels are the fun of this game.

title: Electronic World Z
description: Electronic World Z is a 2D Challenging Platform game based on the story of a Robot called DGIN TV whose mission is to collect all of the Electronic components required to reinstate the Giant Power Generator device in "Z" Power Station.

title: Cub Gym
description: A challenging and fun crazy scavenger hunt game.

title: Dreamer
description: A dreamy and overcoming journey that will enchant and thrill you at each end of a complete act, embark with the Dreamer on this dream, overcome your fears and conquer.

title: Nothing to Remember

Through their personal messages, you'll uncover two characters unknowingly intertwined as they hunt a killer long thought dead. When your next choice could mean life or death, will you answer the call?

title: Ghost Cash Collect
description: Join the young ghost on his epic adventure to find money!

title: Adapted Adventures: Crystal Cave

description: Moonlight Blade Mobile is a genuine MMORPG mobile game based on the Wuxia stories of famous novelist Gulong and authorized by the core team of PC online game.

title: The Bits That Saved the Galaxy
description: Grab up to three friends for a lo-fi, bit blasting adventure! Fight your way through unique worlds and play styles to save the galaxy!

title: Crown of the Empire
