title: FIFA 22: Legacy Edition
description: Powered by Football, FIFA 22 brings the game even closer to the real thing with fundamental gameplay advances and a new season of innovation across every mode.

title: When the Lying Petals Scatter Into the Wind
description: A side story of visual novel "Flowers Blooming at the End of Summer".

title: Car Physics Simulator: Trucks + Missions DLC
description: Playable Trucks and Truck Missions.

title: OMSI 2: Yorkshire Counties
description: Welcome to Yorkshire Counties, a Fictional Map inspired by the UK areas of Yorkshire. The map has tight roads and an even tighter Timetable this map will challenge even the most experienced OMSI Driver.

title: OMSI 2: C2-Stadtbus-Familie Vol.1
description: The new C2 city bus family is a vehicle add-on created by OMSI 2 fans for OMSI 2 fans. A total of 7 different versions of the popular C2 bus are waiting to be used in the OMSI 2 bus simulator.

title: OMSI 2: Velbert
description: With the new OMSI 2 add-on Velbert you have now the opportunity to explore another city in NRW in the heart of the Niederbergisches Land with 2 full bus lines. Over 200 new real buildings were developed especially for this add-on and make the city of Velbert look very realistic.

title: OMSI 2: IVECO Bus Family Interurban Generation
description: IVECO, the world leader in intercity buses, launched its new coach range in 2013 under the new IVECO BUS brand. Discover this new series of intercity buses in OMSI now!

title: OMSI 2: Three Generations
description: Take a seat and enjoy the ride - welcome to the articulated buses in Hamburg! "Three Generations" is the first add-on especially developed for OMSI 2 with not only new vehicles but a whole lot of new and unique features which as such have never before been available in OMSI 2.

title: OMSI 2: Man DN95
description: Hardly any other bus has shaped the cityscape as much as the MAN DN95. This double-decker bus, originally called MAN ND202, belongs to Berlin like the Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag or the TV tower.

title: OMSI 2: Digibus Phantom
description: The Phantom is based on the high-floor version of the Optare Spectra, which first appeared on British roads in 1992 and is a modern evolution of the MCW Metrobus.

title: OMSI 2: Mallorca
description: The omnibus simulator captures the famous holiday island! With the OMSI 2 Add-on Mallorca the player can experience the popular beach region on the Balearic Islands along the Platja de Palma cities Palma, Can Pastilla, El Molinar S’Arenal.

title: OMSI 2: City Bus O305
description: Relive the history of the German omnibuses on your computer at home and explore the technology of the Citybus O305. Do not only drive a bus with automatic transmission, but be the first in an OMSI add-on to control a bus with manual transmission in the busy city traffic.

title: OMSI 2: Köln
description: As the biggest city in North Rhine-Westphalia, Cologne has an extensive public transit network. The city railway and bus lines are being operated by the Kölner Verkehrsbetriebe AG (KVB).

title: OMSI 2: Vienna
description: A piece of history is back! Discover the busline 24A from Zentrum Kagran (U) to the outskirts of the town in the 22nd district of Vienna in the high-floor bus LU 200.

title: OMSI 2: Metropole Ruhr
description: „Metropole Ruhr“ is the most comprehensive OMSI add-on to date – featuring a map more than twice as large as the Project Gladbeck map. You can experience Germany’s largest metropolitan area on more than 800 km of drivable route, more than 50 bus lines in 15 Ruhr cities and along 2,000 custom buildings and objects as well as on a fully...

title: OMSI 2: Vienna 1 - Line 24A
description: Have you ever dreamt of being a bus driver? Well, now you can take your seat behind the steering wheel of faithfully recreated service buses of the “Wiener Linien”!

title: Minable & Create
description: World-building RPG "Minable & Create" is an easy-to-understand 2D screen sandbox game. Basically anything can be dug and you can create your own base with the acquired materials. Find and collect the people who were attacked by the Demon King and scattered, and save the world.

title: OMSI 2: Doppelgelenkbus AGG 300
description: Drive extra large! Fully functional bi-articulated buses are now possible with OMSI 2.3. This add-on brings the 80-ft Van Hool true-to-life into your OMSI, based on real buses from Hamburg.

title: OMSI 2: Strassenbahn NF6D Essen/Gelsenkirchen
description: OMSI 2 premiere – Get on rails in the popular bus simulation at the Ruhr district for the first time. 15 tram stops (two of those subway stops) through challenging alleys from Essen to the broader streets of Gelsenkirchen.

title: OMSI 2: Citybus i260 Series
description: Citybus i260 - City bus of large capacity. This is a high-floor bus with 3 doors, engine in the center and rear wheel drive.

title: OMSI 2: Express 91.06
description: The add-on "Express 91.06" is a semi-fictitious French map that will allow you to discover the express line 91.06. It starts at the bus station of Massy Palaiseau in France and allows you to cross a plateau inspired by the French Silicon Valley.

title: OMSI 2: Bad Hügelsdorf 2020
description: The Baden County in the southwest of Germany is considered one of the most scenic areas of the German republic. It is in this landscape that the OMSI2 add-on Bad Huegelsdorf 2020 plays.

title: OMSI 2: Luzern - Linie 24
description: Line 24 leads from the Lucerne main railway station across the lake bridge towards the traffic building to Meggen. At the crossing of the lake, passengers can admire the world-famous "Kapellbrücke" with its striking tower.

title: OMSI 2: Berlin X10
description: X10 Berlin - The express bus between City West and Brandenburg is the first add-on for "OMSI 2" created by the developers of Halycon. The modern Berlin out of the perspective of a bus driver is a captivating experience. It`s a challenge to take on the daily schedule without accidents.

title: OMSI 2: Urbino Stadtbusfamilie
description: The add-on “Urbino Citybus Series” for OMSI 2 includes two 18 m articulated buses, two 12 m solo buses, and one 15 m three-axle solo bus.

title: OMSI 2: Aachen
description: In the OMSI 2: Aachen – The imperial city“, the Aachen bus routes 33 and 73 with a total length of 22km have been faithfully recreated. These two routes run through the old emperor city, from the town’s east into the thriving city centre.

title: OMSI 2: Saint-Servan
description: The OMSI 2-AddOn Saint-Servan presents 8 lines of this large network connecting the center of Saint-Servan with the districts and villages in the north of the metropolis (such as Salérin, Monfort-sur-Rhé, Le Roc Saint-André, etc.).

title: OMSI 2: K-Bergbahn
description: The beautiful town „Zille“ is a tourist place in Sauerland. Especially many tourists from Lower Saxony and Ruhr district go there. They have the opportunity to spend a nice day or even a vacation in „Zille“.

title: OMSI 2: Busbetrieb-Simulator
description: The Bus Company Simulator brings three brand-new features to OMSI 2: Single player and Multiplayer career modes, comprehensive company management and a sophisticated economy system.

title: OMSI 2: Düsseldorf M2
description: With the new OMSI 2 Mini DLC you can expand the OMSI 2 Dusseldorf Add-On by another 11km drivable route in the northern part of the city with the Metrobus line M2.

title: OMSI 2: Düsseldorf - Linie 721
description: With the new OMSI 2 mini add-on you can expand the OMSI 2 Düsseldorf add-on route by another 17km drivable route across the city center with the line 721.

title: OMSI 2: Rheinhausen
description: Variety is the spice of life. And the OMSI 2 Add-On- Rheinhausen is certainly jam-packed with variety. As well as the challenges of driving a bus in urban traffic, virtual bus drivers also have tempting opportunities to manoeuvre a large vehicle safely through traffic on interurban routes.

title: OMSI 2: Wuppertal Buslinie 639
description: With the new OMSI 2 Mini DLC you expand Wuppertal by 6km mobile route through the mountains of the district Sonnborn. Here you connect with the new bus line 639 the mountainous regions of Wuppertal with the suspension railway, the S-Bahn station Zoologischer Garten and the green Wuppertal Zoo.

title: OMSI 2: Leitstellen-Simulator
description: Join a control center event as a bus driver at any time and be part of it! Work together with the control center to complete your shifts perfectly and get the passengers to their destination safely and on time.

title: OMSI 2: Berlin BRT
description: Berlin BRT - Bus Rapid Transit is the new OMSI map for all Berlin lovers!

title: OMSI 2: Projekt Gladbeck
description: Hop on and be a bus driver on more than 35 recreated bus lines through cities like Gladbeck, Bottrop, Gelsenkirchen, Essen, Recklinghausen, Marl and Dortmund! Here´s the deal: 1,000 objects and buildings on 500km of accessible route - guaranteeing more than 2,000 hours of driving fun!

title: OMSI 2: Hamburger Buspaket
description: The vehicle expansion “Hamburg Buses” adds three of Hamburg’s city buses from the latest 2017 generation to OMSI. This includes the 21 metre long large-capacity articulated bus with 4 axles as well as the solo and articulated variants with 12 and 13 metres, respectively.

title: OMSI 2: Citybus O305G
description: The „Citybus O305G“ allows you to take a journey through time. The „Citybus O305G “ as a pure vehicle add-on aims to build a virtual monument for the articulated pusher busses of the first generation and sends you right back in the early 1980s.

title: OMSI 2: Chicago Downtown
description: Catch a fresh breeze for OMSI 2: Chicago is the third largest city of the U.S. and delivers an unique scenario with completely new vehicles and scenery objects. Welcome to "Windy City" at Lake Michigan!

title: OMSI 2: München City
description: „The heartfelt cosmopolitan city“! With the new OMSI 2 add-on München City players will be driving modern MAN Lion's City buses through central Munich with some of its scenic boroughs like Schwabing, Maxvorstadt, Lehel, Haidhausen and Bogenhausen.

title: OMSI 2: Bremen-Nord
description: Following the OMSI add-ons Berlin X10 and Rheinhausen, the third OMSI routes add-on from Halycon Media takes players to the beautiful city of Bremen in northern Germany.

title: OMSI 2: VanHool Generationen Reihe
description: With the new and complimentary DLC „VanHool Generationen Reihe“ we get the forgotten coach series of VanHool on your harddrive. Twelve different busses are in the pack included.

title: OMSI 2: Citybus 628c & 628g LF
description: Citybus 628c & 628g LF – add-on for OMSI 2 depicting realistic buses manufactured in Turkey, dedicated to Middle-East Europe, cheaper version of bus called a o530 produced in Germany.

title: OMSI 2: OmniNavigation
description: The navigation system clearly shows you your current route and your current location. So you don't need the often confusing OMSI 2 help arrows anymore and you can easily find the right way at every intersection.

title: OMSI 2: Hamburg
description: OMSI: Hamburg is an add-on for OMSI - The Bus Simulator for PC. Drive your 40ft city bus from the 1990s in multiple versions on the authentic Hamburg bus line 109 and 688.

title: OMSI 2: E-Bus Hamburg
description: Vision becomes reality – after the first battery electric buses of the type eCitaro have been standardly put in operation in Hamburg in summer 2018, this modern city bus now finds its way into OMSI 2 as well.

title: OMSI 2: HafenCity - Hamburg Modern
description: On the road again in the Hanseatic city! With two modern hybrid buses, the OMSI 2 add-on “HafenCity – Hamburg modern” takes you along two new lines through the “Speicherstadt” (warehouse district) and “HafenCity” (HarbourCity).

title: OMSI 2: Vienna 2 - Line 23A
description: Have you ever dreamt of being a bus driver? Well, now you can take your seat behind the steering wheel of faithfully recreated service buses of the “Wiener Linien”!

title: OMSI 2: Düsseldorf
description: Experience the North Rhine-Westphalian regional capital with two Urbino IV versions on routes for five accessible bus lines – amongst others the metrobus line M3. Pass skyscrapers and drive through the daily rush hour in the midst of the city.

title: OMSI 2: Grand Paris-Moulon
description: Bienvenue en France! We are heading back to France. The Add-on Grand Paris Moulon - With the Express 91.06 through France from developer Creations AgoraS-114 plays in the area south of Paris.

title: OMSI 2: Wuppertal
description: On the road in Wuppertal: With the new OMSI 2 Add-on Wuppertal you now have the opportunity to discover the “large green city” with lots of realistically modelled buildings along 21 km of route.

title: Streets of Rage 4: Anniversary Edition
description: Streets of Rage 4 is an all-new continuation of the iconic arcade brawler series known for its radical fights, jammin’ ‘90s beats and dashing sparring gloves and bandanas. The Streets of Rage 4: Anniversary Edition includes the base game, 3 new playable characters, new weapons and enemies, and character customization where you can build your own fighting style with new moves.

title: Tropico 6: Lobbyistico
description: Join the EU in their investigations into 'corruptionomics' and unlock new powerful perks in 'Lobbyistico' for Tropico 6.

title: Tropico 6: Spitter
description: It's all about the fame and prestige. Nobody knows this better than a self-declared statesman, such as El Presidente. Tropico 6's second DLC skyrockets you into the world of stardom and illustriousness.

title: SpaceShooter
description: Blast through endless waves of deadly meteors in a fast-paced 2D arcade space shooter! Fight through 20 challenging stages, battle powerful bosses, customize your ship, discover unique meteor types, unlock weapons and upgrades, and survive the Endless Mode.

title: Wars Across The World: Levant 1941
description: Levant 1941 is the Second World War in the Middle East. The British Empire must successively crush the coup in Iraq, seize Vichy France-held Syria and Lebanon, before finally entering Iran to set up a supply route to the Soviet Union. The Axis must do its utmost to prevent this strict schedule.

title: The Escapists 2: Dungeons and Duct Tape
description: This content requires the base game The Escapists 2 on steam in order to play.

title: The Escapists 2: Big Top Breakout
description: A clown's life awaits in Big Top Breakout!

title: Wars Across the World: Serbia 1914
description: Serbia 1914 simulates the Austro-Hungarian offensives against Serbia and Montenegro during the first month of WW1, in the Balkans. Three Austrian armies must crush Serbian forces and capture Belgrade. The Serbians are powerful, but their resources are scarce, whether to resist...or counter-attack!

title: Wars Across the World: Mexico 1519
description: In April 1519, Hernán Cortés lands on the Gulf of Mexico coastline at the head of a Spanish expedition from Cuba, where he establishes the city of Villa Rica de Vera Cruz. Local population welcome is warm, as they see him as the envoy of the god Quetzalcóatl (the famous feathered serpent).

title: Wars Across the World: Franche-Comté 1636
description: Franche-Comté 1636 takes place during the so-called Ten Years' war, in the Modern era. The Franche-Comté player has to repel the French and Weimarian assaults by defending strategic places. This scenario allows Francs-Comtois to win by a diplomatic victory later in the game, via a peace treaty.

title: Wars Across the World: Illyria 229
description: Illyria 229 BC. Rome is looking eastward. In the Adriatic Sea, Illyrian pirates wage terror and their exactions push Rome to intervene. The Illyrians must capture a maximum of Greek cities while avoiding being crushed by Roman Legions and ships.

title: Wars Across the World: Switzerland 1937
description: Switzerland 1937 is the simulation of a fictive civil war in Switzerland, based on the unfinished and unpublished novel 'Eternal War'. It's the history of a Europe that never could recover from World War One and the Great Depression. In most European countries, conditions prevailing are tantamount to civil war.

title: Wars Across the World: Nordwind 1945
description: Nordwind 1945 is the last German offensive in the west. By New Year's eve, the Germans enter Alsace from the north and try to reach Saverne,pushing back American and French forces. Can the Allies contain and then repulse their enemy, in the midst of one of the most severe winter of the period in the area?

title: Wars Across the World: Galicia 1914
description: Galicia 1914 is the story of the first weeks of the Great War between Russia and Austria-Hungary. Three Austrian armies (plus one soon coming from Serbia) are initially deployed against 4 armies of the Czar. Can Austria-Hungary keep the control of Galicia in front of the Russian steamroller?

title: Wars Across the World: Columbus 1492
description: Columbus 1492 retraces the exceptional and tragic journey of the discoverer of America, Christopher Columbus. You will discover the unknown, build colonies and search for gold. Opposition will be great, between storms, mutinies and natives, not to mention many other pitfalls on the road to glory...

title: Wars Across the World: Korea 1592
description: Korea 1592 relates the story of the Imjin War, the toughest conflict in the end of the 16th century in Asia, depicting the invasion of the Joeson kingdom of Korea by the Samurai armies of Japan's master, Hideyoshi.

title: Wars Across the World: Uganda 1979
description: Uganda 1979 is the depiction of the last offensive of megalomaniac tyrant of Uganda, Amin Dada, against his neighbour Tanzania from 1978. The Ugandans must hold the province of Kagera and repel the enemy offensive. Tanzanians must first and foremost overthrow Amin Dada by capturing his capital.

title: Wars Across the World: Soccer 1969
description: Soccer 1969 relates the 'Soccer War' that opposed Honduras and Salvador in July 1969 following a very tense football game. The Salvadoran army sets up an offensive with the aim of overthrowing Honduras president, accused of spoliation against Salvadorian immigrants.

title: Wars Across the World: Kippur 1973
description: Kippur 1973 allows to replay the Arab-Israeli war of October 1973. The Arab side, mostly Egypt and Syria, attacks Israeli troops by surprise simultaneously in the Sinai and the Golan, to get a foothold again on their land claims. Israel must hold and then counter-attack to obtain victory.

title: Wars Across the World: Bouvines 1214
description: Bouvines 1214 tells the War of 1213-1214 between crown of France against a coalition of England, Flanders and Holy Roman Empire. The French must consolidate their gains and punish the rebel Count of Flanders. The Coalition needs to spread out French forces, defeat them and stop the rise of France.

title: Wars Across the World: Burma 1942
description: Burma 1942 is the recreation of the Japanese onslaught against Burma in the first months of 1942. Four Japanese divisions, supported by their Thai allies must conquer the whole of Burma before Monsoon sets in.

title: Wars Across the World: Coral Sea 1942
description: Coral Sea 1942 covers the May 1942 Japanese invasion attempt of New Guinea, and the air and naval campaigns around it. The Japanese forces must capture Port Moresby and establish bases in the Solomon islands, but their offensive could be well stopped by the Allies naval and air forces.

title: Wars Across the World: Innsmouth 1928
description: Innsmouth 1928 is a simulation of the assault of the Police, FBI and U.S.Coast Guard and National Guard on the degenerate town of Innsmouth, populated by monstrous creatures. This is a mod on the Ctulluh universe.

title: Tropico 6: The Llama of Wall Street
description: It's time to play in the major leagues! El Presidente is descending on the world of international brands, big time. Power in politics is never enough for a man with ambitions as great as El Prez, so join forces with the trustworthy broker, and help Tropico to establish its status as a global megabrand.

title: X4: Cradle of Humanity
description: X4: Cradle of Humanity, the second big expansion for X4: Foundations, significantly increases the size of the game's universe with new sectors, story missions and game-starts, while also welcoming two Terran factions, along with their economy, ships, weapons and stations.

title: Samurai Shodown: Shiro Tokisada Amakusa
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "SHIRO TOKISADA AMAKUSA" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: Samurai Shodown: Mina Majikina
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "MINA MAJIKINA" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: Samurai Shodown: Sogetsu Kazama
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "SOGETSU KAZAMA" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: Samurai Shodown: Cham Cham
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "CHAM CHAM" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: Samurai Shodown: Rimururu
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "RIMURURU" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: Samurai Shodown: Iroha
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "IROHA" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: Samurai Shodown: Hibiki Takane
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "HIBIKI TAKANE" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: Samurai Shodown: Kazuki Kazama
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "KAZUKI KAZAMA" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: Samurai Shodown: Wan-Fu
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "WAN-FU" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: Samurai Shodown: Warden
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "WARDEN" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: Samurai Shodown: Basara
description: This digital purchase will unlock the DLC character "BASARA" for your copy of SAMURAI SHODOWN.

title: BattleTech: Urban Warfare
description: Urban Warfare brings 'Mech combat to the vast cityscapes of the Inner Sphere! Electronic warfare, large-scale building destruction, environmental mechanics, new enemy units and more make the urban sprawl a whole new battlefield.

title: Battletech: Mercenary Collection
description: BATTLETECH Mercenary Collection is the ultimate BATTLETECH bundle, including the Digital Deluxe Edition and the Season Pass, which gives players access to three upcoming expansions.

title: Data East Arcade Collection #1
description:
This bundle includes 8 iconic arcade games from Data East:

- Super BurgerTime
- Gate of Doom
- Super Real Darwin
- Express Raider
- Bad Dudes
- Two Crude
- Joe & Mac - Caveman Ninja
- Heavy Barrel

title: Shenmue III: Big Merry Cruise
description: Various types of entertainment can be enjoyed aboard the ship, as well as challenge missions which can only be played here. Also, new outfits for Ryo can be obtained by clearing mini-quests encountered onboard.

title: Police Quest: SWAT 1+2
description:
This digitally distributed game collection includes:
- Daryl F. Gates' Police Quest: SWAT
- Police Quest: SWAT 2

title: AI War 2: The Spire Rises
description: Tons of new core content -- turrets, Arks, strikecraft, and more. An entirely new way to play -- open warfare instead of guerilla fighting -- if you partner with the Fallen Spire faction. A new level of cunning for the AI if you give them the new Scourge faction as a partner.

title: Wartile: Hel's Nightmare
description: Enjoy five brand new handcrafted battle boards, continuing the story after Niflheim. Each battle board is offering variated tactical challenges, set in a unique mood and style. Lead your Viking fellowship into the Hel's Nightmare accompanied by the new hero Ogier the Dane.

title: Silverfall: Complete
description:
Silverfall: Complete Edition includes the following content:
- Silverfall
- Silverfall: Earth Awakening

title: Parkitect: Booms & Blooms
description: Have a blast creating fireworks displays using the new Effect Sequencer. Plus 2 new thrill rides, 1 water ride, 3 new coasters, 2 updated coasters, and more in the Parkitect: Booms & Blooms Pack.

title: Sands of Fire
description: Take control of forty tons of pure armored destruction! World War II is raging, and the enemy is fighting hard for every inch of territory in North Africa. Devastate the opposing forces with superior tactics, cunning strategy, and tremendous might.

title: Against the Moon: Moonstorm
description: The update tells the new story of the last bastion of humanity. This time, the young warrior Zoy, accompanied by the half-mutated Mazoon, will travel into the heart of Moonstorm to gather resources necessary for survival of the last stronghold of humanity.

title: Interstellar Space: Genesis - Natural Law
description: Interstellar Space: Genesis - Natural Law is an expansion to the turn-based space 4X strategy game Interstellar Space: Genesis. Features 2 new races, equipped with unique new capabilities, also usable by custom races. Also, 9 new fully animated ruler options, 4 new music tracks, and 4 new leaders!

title: West of Dead: Crow
description: The Crow DLC contains, the Crow familiar, a new level (The Battlefield), new enemy (The Captain), a new weapon (The Mortar).

title: King's Quest 1+2+3
description:
This Bundle contains:

- King's Quest: Quest for the Crown.
- King's Quest II: Romancing the Throne.
- King's Quest III: To Heir Is Human.

title: King's Quest 7+8
description:
This bundle contains:

- King’s Quest 7: The Princeless Bride
- King’s Quest 8: Mask of Eternity

title: Pocket Mina
description: J-RPG Turn Based battle-oriented game. Emphasize on the item's mechanics & gameplay. Made with RPG Maker XP.

title: Iron Harvest: Rusviet Revolution
description: Players will follow an additional story line over the course of four new singleplayer maps, shedding some light on the mysterious Rasputin.

title: Ne no Kami: The Two Princess Knights of Kyoto - Extra Story
description: Ne no Kami - The Two Princess Knights of Kyoto Extra Story features two extra after story chapters.

title: Real Heroes: Firefighter HD
description: In this first-person fire and rescue action game, don the soot-stained boots of an everyday hero, as a newly graduated academy cadet getting their start in a big city fire station. Face the heat on the front line as you save people and animals from fiery danger to become a real hero!

title: Galactic Civilizations III: Revenge of the Snathi
description: The Snathi have risen from the ashes of their Precursor prison world. Lead this evil new empire of bloodthirsty squirrels to galactic domination in sandbox and their own campaign.

title: Galactic Civilizations III: Altarian Prophecy
description: Lead the newly founded Terran Alliance in its first encounter with the Altarian Confederation. Adds two new factions, a 3 mission campaign scenario and more.

title: Galactic Civilizations III: Heroes of Star Control - Origins
description: The Tywom, Mu'Kay, Mowlings and other unique alien species from the Star Control: Origins universe have come to Galactic Civilizations III! Each alien race includes a unique leader, ship designs, traits, music, and more.

title: Tezz: Portals
description: Tezz: Portals is a block-fit puzzle with portals.

title: Modern Puzzle
description: A beautiful puzzle game in which you have to collect the pieces of animated characters. The game provides a choice of difficulty and any available level to choose from. Time and lives are limited, so hurry up

title: Dungeons of Dredmor: Realm of the Diggle Gods
description: Deep within their underground temples, Lord Dredmor plots the next stage in his campaign of merciless brutality and world-terrorizing.

title: The Desolate Hospital
description: The Desolate Hospital is a horror adventure game where a gas masked man explores a desolate hospital to recover a red jewel. Upon entering, he receives a letter that reads, "If you wish to live, you must completely purge this place.

title: Flight of the Amazon Queen: Legacy Edition
description: The Legacy Edition of "Flight of the Amazon Queen", using latest ScummVM software to run on modern platforms (Windows, macOS and Linux).

title: Patrician 1+2
description:
In this bundle you can have two great trade games, predecessors to Patrician 3, in the price of just one! Set against the historical backdrop of maritime trade at the time of the Hanseatic League, the Patrician series sees the player take the role of a citizen of a medieval hanseatic town in Northern Europe, between London and Novgorod, with the aim being to rise from the status of an ordinary, unimportant trader to that of a major business tycoon and governor of your hometown.

To achieve this goal, the player must gain the respect and recognition of other inhabitants and try to make a profit through maritime trade, the production of goods and the completion of missions. The player can raise his profile by both improving the city and through diplomacy, or by raising money for his treasury by means of piracy and smuggling - but watch out, others want easy money too, so you would do wise to arm your ships!

title: CyberBorn
description: Welcomme to Cyberborn! A truly Cyberpunk Multiplayer FPS game. The game using Unreal Engine 4 , 5 Different very high detailed maps, with 5 different game modes. 5 Different Class , and 4 different ability. The Game is working on Online , and on LAN as well. Your PC is ready? "No More Future"

title: Aircraft War: Space Wars
description: New DLC has been added to Aircraft War. With this DLC pack, the war has been moved into space. You will fight with your own spaceships against enemy space warships. Space Wars are waiting for you.

title: Into the Pyramid
description: Into the Pyramid is the new multiplayer game from Aisukaze Studio, be part of the team trying to scape from the pyramid or sabotage the mission for your own interests.

title: Don't Miss the King
description: Dont miss the king is a strategy-platformer game that lets you strategize while you are in battle. You will be able to fight using different types of soldiers on many different maps in this game where you have to defeat a dark wizard-king who is trying to take all of humanity under his will.

title: Drabidiboo
description: A strategic game of prediction, collection and magical pets!

title: Diamond Hunter
description: A mystery adventure game where you will need to use your orientation skills to avoid getting lost in the mazes.

title: Save the Astronaut
description: You're stranded. Navigate a perilous uncharted world full of freezing waters, and razor sharp rocks. You have ten seconds to breathe. Don't choke.

title: Escape from Kyoto House
description: Your party finds themselves trapped in a Japanese-themed room. Solve puzzles, crack riddles and discover hidden secrets in your adventure to Escape from Kyoto House!

title: Azure Sky
description: Azure Sky is an action, puzzle and platform game. You need to take on the role of a young man, who will later gain power over his consciousness and learn to master magical abilities.

title: Lunar Lich
description: Lunar Lich is a puzzle-solving game including puzzle solving, chasing, dialogue options, and a small amount of battle. The game contains a certain amount of horror effects and jump-scares, but the adventure is more significant. This game is very suitable for leisure and entertainment.

title: Sylphine
description: Discover your destiny in a world where two dimensions collide in a conflict that threatens all life. Explore two unique dimensions, cultivate friendships, and form relationships as you delve into the world of Sylphine!

title: Isles of Cubes
description: Strategy Puzzle Game. Explore and colonize islands. Establish production chains. But your resources and space are limited. You must plan carefully.

title: UnderRail: Expedition
description: Take a break from the usual metro-crawling to take a boat to the infamous Black Sea. There, among the ruins of an age long past, you’ll face the vicious fauna, hostile natives, cunning pirates, and something far more sinister than all of those.

title: Nikola Tesla: War of the Currents
description: Help the eccentric inventor navigate the intrigue of the emerging electrical industry! Can you outsmart Thomas Edison and electrify the world?

title: Recursive Hate: Spider Hell
description: Try to survive in Spider Hell. Fight with big, realistic and terrifying spiders and versus swarms with literally thousands of spiders.

title: Grass Cutters Academy
description: Are you interested in gardening? painting? how about a mix of both? In Grass Cutters Academy you cut grass for money, spend that money on paint powered auto mowers that get faster, stronger and more efficient with each blade of grass cut

title: Wars Across the World: Fornovo 1495
description: Fornovo 1495 is the story of the first 'War of Italy', with the expedition of French king Charles VIII against Naples. The French objective is to capture the key city of Naples and keep it against their adversaries.

title: Dream Stone 2
description: Escaping from the dream still continues on the sequel of Dream Stone.

title: Memory Card Monsters
description: Finding pairs might sound easy, but this game will definitely challenge your brain! Train your memory, concentration, accuracy, attention, the speed of thinking and logic skills and much more. This game is a great way to exercise your memory and keep your brain fit!

title: Robot Rogue
description: Robot Rogue is a turn-based roguelike game featuring skill system. You have 3 skills and each skill have own attack area, attack damage, and cost of use. Cast a best skill on situation, and clear the dungeon!

title: Kenbo
description: On the warpath again comes a former military man named Kenbo, he swore not to kill again, but some special services again want to recruit him, so Kenbo took up arms and promised to kill anyone who comes to him.

title: The Tower of TigerQiuQiu: Nyaa Invaders 1
description: About Alien cats are hungry and ready to invade the earth. If you fly the most advanced cat lunch box spaceship, you must feed them before they starve. Save the earth!

title: The Tower of TigerQiuQiu: Tiger Tank 63
description: Adding weather systems to the battlefield, heavy rains can break walls and cause mud on the ground; persistent rainstorms can make roads water; cooling from snowy days can freeze water; and when temperatures rise, ice and snow melt. The changing weather changed the terrain of the battlefield.

title: The Abnormal Place
description: The Abnormal Place is a game about Abigail, a young woman who has lost her voice and has found herself in a strange resort and hotel inhabited by monsters. Abigail must recover her voice and navigate through the hostile world or she'll be forever trapped.

title: A Traveler's Photo Album
description: You will play a traveler, strayed into a castle, the owner of the castle is a candid expert, in the different world travel around the use of magic candid, have a thick album, which is full of treasures! You find the photo album, but the photos in the album are sealed in the room, you need to open it.

title: Muslim 3D
description: Muslim 3D is an educational video game. You begin your journey in a virtual place in the city of Makkah. Interact with other, virtual people, go on adventurous quests, go back in time to relive a historic moment, or perform a Virtual Hajj!

title: Hand of Fate 2: Outlands and Outsiders
description: Hand of Fate 2: Outlands and Outsiders DLC expands the Game of Life and Death with a brand new campaign challenge and a unique companion character.

title: Fisherman Classic
description: Welcome to Fishy Archipelago! Go fishing, catalog your most rare fishes and sea creatures, buy and find skins, hats, boats and properties. Build your fishy empire. The retro world is yours!

title: Profectus
description:
Rise through the ages.
In Profectus you start with nothing but a world to explore. Your goal is to use what you are given to full extent and work your way up from the stone age into space.

Profectus is unique in that you do not have an inventory, you have to carry everything you own in your hands, on your hips or on your back.

title: BlockWorld
description: BlockWorld is a Multiplayer Voxel sandbox full of toys and creatures! Powered by the Hazzah Engine, you can go beyond blocks and really build amazing things. Come on in and build worlds with your friends!

title: Purgo Box
description: This game is an online multiplayer game created in RPG Tutool. Collect items, increase the heroine's sensitivity, and aim for the ending.

title: Shadows: Awakening - Necrophage's Curse
description: Gear up, pull yourself together and set off to confront the Necrophage – the Eater of the Dead – before it’s too late.

title: Shadows: Awakening - The Chromaton Chronicles
description: Shadows: Awakening – The Chromaton Chronicles leads you to the northern edge of Thole. There lies the mysterious Arcanum Laboratory – a long since abandoned place known for its ruthless and immoral magical experiments.

title: Epic Pinball: The Complete Collection
description: This release is an Epic Pinball compilation with some exclusive content. It includes the first 8 tables plus the tables: Cyborgirl, Pangaea, Space Journey, Toy Factory and African Safari.

title: Hentai Fighter
description: Hentai Fighter is a classic fighting game with sexy anime girls inspired by classical fighting games. Easy to learn and play!

title: Train Simulator 2021: BR Class 07 Loco Add-On
description: One of the smallest classes of diesel shunters built for workings around one of the UK's largest dockyards is now here for Train Simulator 2021. The diminutive 0-6-0 Class 07 shunter was designed specifically for use within Southampton Dockyard and to replace aging tank steam locomotives used previously.

title: Microcosmum: Survival of Cells - Campaign "Hot and Cold"
description: We present you a new additional campaign of 50 missions. Temperature fluctuations appeared in the microcosmum. Now microorganisms slow down in cold areas and accelerate in warm ones. Use it in your tactics!

title: The Unexpected Quest Prologue
description: Adventure game with strategy and management elements in a medieval fantasy setting - drawing inspiration from classic games of the genre. In this prologue, play through chapters 1, 2, and 3, where you learn to manage your resources as you build and battle to bring order to the world.

title: Train Simulator 2021: Western Sichuan Pass: Dujiangyan - Maoxian & Mashancun Route Add-On
description: The Western Sichuan Pass delivers unique mountainside passenger operations throughout the Sichuan province of Southwest China, and is brought to life, courtesy of Partner Programme developer, Simtech Vision.

title: The Trap
description: The Trap is a mod featuring: The atmosphere of Valve's Portal game, many incredible puzzles, an achievement system, a long time to the end, and the trap is for your brain.

title: Data Mining 8
description: Data Mining 8 is a casual colorful minimalist puzzle in which you have to collect all the files that are not corrupted to exit the closed circle.

title: Fantasy Mosaics 34: Zen Garden
description: The penguin family discovered a "Zen" way to play multi-color mosaic puzzles.

title: Battle Brothers: Lindwurm
description: Challenge your mercenary company against a fearsome Lindwurm, an adversary of legend, home to the wild parts of the world and fiercely defending its hoard of treasure.

title: Endless Furry Killer 3D
description: Endless Furry Killer 3D is the second installment of the Endless Furry Series! The game is currently a work in progress.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Wolf - Wrath of the Damned
description: Warhammer 40,000: Space Wolf is a card-driven turn-based tactical game which features RPG elements, containing a single player campaign, survival and PvP modes. Win these battles using the arsenal of weapons, abilities and cunning of the sky warriors. The Wrath of the Damned DLC includes a new PvE arena marking the next step in the evolution of the acclaimed The Fall of Kanak mode, new heroes, and a new set of cards for the main game and new achievements.

title: Sudoku Time
description: Sudoku Time is a classic logical puzzle with combinatorics of numbers. The goal of the puzzle is to fill in the empty cells with numbers from 1 to 9 so that in each row, in each column, and in each small square (region) 3 × 3, each digit occurs only once. Each puzzle has only one solution!

title: Train Simulator 2021: Montana Hi-Line - Shelby: Havre Route
description: The eastern segment of BNSF's famed and busy Hi-Line Subdivision crosses the magnificent and fertile high plains of Montana - and the remarkable experiences of railroading in America's "Big Sky Country" now comes to Train Simulator 2021 with the Montana Hi-Line route!

title: American Truck Simulator: Cabin Accessories
description: There is no place like home and for many drivers on the road, their truck cab is their second home. From power inverters to coffee cups, the possibilities for cab customizations are (almost) endless!

title: Fairy Godmother Stories: Dark Deal - Collector's Edition
description:
This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes: defeat an evil witch's fairy-tale guards in the bonus game; replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games; tons of morphs and collectibles to find; strategy guide, exclusive wallpapers, concept art, music, videos, and more!

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- Defeat an evil witch's fairy-tale guards in the bonus game!
- Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games!
- Tons of morphs and collectibles to find, including coins you can use to purchase fairy-tale memorabilia!
- Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, concept art, music, videos, and more!
- Never get lost with the strategy guide!

title: Fairy Godmother Stories: Dark Deal
description: Domini Games proudly brings you the follow up to the modern fairy tale original in Fairy Godmother Stories: Dark Deal! Grab your magic wand and step into the shoes of a real fairy godmother in this spell-binding Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!

title: Death Dream
description: You find yourself in a galaxy with maps, on maps you can survive, build cities, extract resources, trade, defend against enemies, maps can be opened in a dream, when you make your bed and fall asleep, then you may dream of a quest, for example, a battle with a dragon, or dialogue with AI

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Animals

title: Tales of Lagoona 3: Frauds, Forgeries, and Fishsticks

title: Sir Stretchalot: The Wenches in the Well
description: Put on the helmet and become more than a man. Become Sir Stretchalot, a Stretcher who travels the land, saving the day and stretching hotties, whether they be Monster Girls or regular girls. Sir Stretchalot is an episodic experience. New episodes will be added regularly.

title: Sometimes Always Monsters: Author Outfits
description: Get fresh new looks for each of the writers, with the Author Outfits DLC Pack. Including redesigned sprites, portraits, and animations, this visual makeover will add new life and new style to your second (or twenty-second) play through of Sometimes Always Monsters.

title: TrackMaster: Free For All Motorsport

Peer into Noah's memories and relive the couple's happiest moments through choice based dialogue, a unique art-style, and an original soundtrack in this fully voice acted experience.

Use your special gifts and divine powers to challenge the marches of hell and turn the tide against these devils and demons.

title: LuLu Looking For Dogs

This game includes a fully voiced main protagonist, a fully made custom map to explore, and a set of 6 different unique weapons to fight the undead. This creepy atmosphere adventure will feel like a throwback to old zombie games where it's just you, a pistol, and a horde of zombies trying to kill you.

Each level has a lot of coins, and there are obstacles that are destroyed when you collect the required amount of coins, and then you can go through the level further. Further on the levels, enemy characters appear, which, like obstacles, prevent your hero from advancing along the level. Sneak and Hide quietly to avoid the undead, or blast your way through the hordes with guns out, making every bullet count. Help other survivors to earn resources for crafting, or let the weak fend for themselves - You'll face the consequences of your choices.

description: Relax and farm in the perfect world inside of ZenFarm game. Zen is for finding inner piece and harmony during your hard days in this beautiful farming game. Find your ZEN during farming!

title: River Attack
description: Embark on an exciting journey inspired by classics, facing challenges along the river, rescuing refugees, and demolishing obstacles. Acquire airplanes, collect power-ups, and choose between Classic and Mission modes. An intense experience awaits you!

title: Goner
description: Goner is a thrilling new take on survival / adventure genres, telling the story about a son that, following his missing mother's researchy, will get him to an unknown island... Stranded and alone, your rescue mission will turn quickly into a desperate fight for survival.

title: The Deepest
description: Explore the depths, gather materials, these caves must have an end. Beware of creatures and save materials, look for guiding lights.

title: Dead Hospital
description:
the world is dying.

it's april first - all the local news stations have begun extensive coverage of an unknown disease making all food items inedible. your world will soon succumb to famine. people flood into hospitals in hopes of treating symptoms of the disease, and the sky turns dark under an eternal red moon.

title: Techlie
description: Techlie is a first-person shooter action game that progresses part by part, where you fight in another dimension as the scientist named "Aziz".

title: Egypt Picross: Pharaoh's Riddles
description: Solve the secret of the pharaoh and find pyramids’ treasure in Pharaoh's Riddles! New egyptian riddles await you!

title: Rubble Bubble
description: Get ready to Rubble! Align 3+ colors to clear pieces.

title: Last Generation: Survival
description: Last Generation: Survival is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world where robots have conquered the world.

title: Isometric Nonogram
description: Isometric version of classic nonograms. 3 visible sides of the cube are not independent. They are making common rows and columns with each other and it brings a fresh new feeling to the famous game.

title: Rise of Zombies
description: Rise Of Zombies is a first person shooter action zombie killing game with endless rounds of increasing number and strength of the zombies you will face a strong monster that tries to kill you. you kill zombies to get score points to buy weapons. you are soldier trapped in an excavation site.

title: Space Probes
description: Space Probes is a Shoot Em Up (SHMUP) inspired by productions from the 90s released on SNES, MEGADRIVE, NEO-GEO, PC-ENGINE etc.

title: Snow Trail
description: Snow Trail is a puzzle game that revolves around pushing snow blocks in order to reach a goal. Snow blocks can be pushed into water to create bridges, placed on pressure plates to open certain areas and much more! With 100 levels and multiple mechanics, each level has its own tricks!

title: Input Out
description: Input Out is a Puzzle game where the player commands a circle to the goal by Inputting movement commands. Navigate your way through 100 levels filled with different threats and interesting obstacles. Can you Input your way Out?

title: Rogue Snow: Everwinter
description: Six months have passed since the Everwinter began, covering the world in a permanent frost. Now it is up to a lone scavenger to help his camp reach the equator, in hopes of escaping the harsh climate and the roaming monster snowmen known only as the Droves.

title: Wolf Territory
description: Wolf Territory is a survival adventure game. It's the story of Kyle and his friends who lost their way in the forest.

title: The Last Order: Dungeons
description: The world is headed for destruction. Olvelia and Olvelius (members of the last order) need your help. Only the three of you can prevent the coming catastrophe and change the fate of the world.

title: The Episodic
description: The Episodic is about an astronaut who came back to the earth and finds out that the earth is destroyed by a something big. The player needs to find out what caused this problem.

title: Incarna: Raid
description: Incarna Studios presents R-AI-D, a single-player VR adventure/puzzle game. Your mission: to find and destroy the mysterious errors that are plaguing SENS, the AI that oversees Incarna’s entire interdimensional network.

title: Young Archaeologist
description: Our main character is a young archaeologist, our main task is to get to all the fossils

title: Laser Burst
description: Laser Burst is a logical puzzle game that requires you to methodically rotate and position double sided mirrors that direct lasers through a maze to pop balloons.

title: Psychic Guardian Super Splendor
description: After being captured by a mysterious group, university student Nagisa Kujo hears a voice in her head telling her she needs to escape. She also discovers that when she presses a button on her belt, she becomes clad in combat gear. With her newfound power, Nagisa fights to stop evil.

title: Planetarian: Snow Globe
description: Planetarian: Snow Globe is a kinetic novel based on a short light novel by the same name that occurs before the events of Planetarian: The Reverie of a Little Planet.

title: Mars Mission
description: The Mars Mission offers real companies and work processes for career orientation! Explore different professions and work processes and find your dream job! You can currently choose between 10 professions and simulate their work processes.

title: Fever: Fight the Fever
description: I am pleased to present you with the very first game from Zin Games LLC! FEVER will take you out of your usual routine and immerse you in the microscopic world of the body. Keep your wits sharp and your reflexes keen while you collect Cellular Residue from enemies to bolster your own forces.

title: Spy Escape
description: This is an escape game where you work together with your partner. One will have to be the agent and the other the hacker, and together you will have to solve the problems to get out. One can't play this game solo, so you have to find a partner online if you want to escape the room.

title: Pistol Master!
description: As a new Pvt on camp Greenwood you will be tested to sharpen your skills as you quickly try to finish each trial. Good luck Pvt as you try your best to work as quickly as possible.

title: Combat Labs
description: No two rounds are the same. Memorise each weapon and master the movement in a fast-paced PS1-styled movement shooter in which you are pitted against an opponent of equal footing - except every round, the load-outs are randomised. Who will win? It only depends on your luck with your load-out.

title: Orbit Outlaws
description: Orbit Outlaws is the definitive physics-based arena combat game. Use gravity to pull off impossible shots in competitive and casual multiplayer. Choose your gun, chassis, and pilot, then upgrade and optimize your loadout as you progress against rival pilots.

title: Love of Dragons
description: Why do dragons dream about red clouds?

title: The Schizophrenic Dynasty of Müller
description: In this visual novel you're a voice in schizophrenic heads of dynasty Müller. You pass from generation to generation and you control your schizophrenic, talking sometimes with him. The important thing is, you shouldn't let your schizophrenic die without offspring, otherwise you'll die with him.

title: A Shopping Trip to Eklan Tor
description: Explore a tiny monster town in VR and search for hidden objects.

title: Dungeon Warriors
description: It is a 3D RPG idle game. The game integrates RPG elements, with skill system, achievement system and very rich equipment system, so that players can experience diversified role-playing fun.

title: Dicey Krime: Traveler of Time
description: After a long time of planning their attack, they are finally ready: Dicey and his group of friends have the mission to fight crime and injustice all over the world. With your help they will combat their enemies travelling to various cities in time.

title: Sorcerous
description: A sudden disappearance will set Apprentice Mage Andraste on the trail of a mystery that unfolds with arcane powers, monster battles and cunning puzzles in the best tradition of turn based RPGs.

title: The Cassir Simulator
description: This is a cashier simulator, you need to serve customers, check and scan products, take money and give change. With the money you earn, you can improve your housing, buy food and medicine. Try to survive in difficult living conditions.

title: Ant Force
description: Playing ant you will have an unbelievable fight with AI.

title: Facettes
description: Explore the story of Facettes as you play as a woman discovering her homosexuality and overcoming her identity crisis. This self-questioning protagonist channels her introspection in her RPG inspired fantasy world: Facettes.

title: My Mind Ghost
description: An interesting story about a little girl lost in a large mansion, her headaches make themselves felt, and the medicine that she took is scattered throughout the rooms, her sick mind has invented ghosts that live around.

title: Fluff Labs
description: Help Fluff labs conquer the world (of the snack industry) by mixing chemicals. In this first person logic puzzle game you need to figure out what colours to mix, seperate and react to finish each level. In each level you race against time to satisfy corporate to advance to the next stage.

title: The End of Dyeus
description: Go in a quest for Dyeus in a primitive and cryptic open world ! Face mysterious assailants in intense and fast paced sword fights, and survive against a carnivorous fauna. Will you uncover the truth about Dyeus?

title: End Reach
description: End Reach is a roguelike top-down shooter inspired by the brutal gore of Hotline Miami and the heart pounding action of Nuclear Throne.

title: Space Force Squadron
description: Space Force Squadron is a horizontal 2d shmup. Choose between 4 pilots with different spaceships and different attributes. Buy upgrades for ships using points earned in battles. This is arcade style game, meaning there is no possibility to save.

title: Gladiators Manager
description: Gladiators Manager puts you in the position of a lanista responsible for training and managing gladiators. Participating in brutal arena fights and cruel intrigues will grant you riches and glory in the ancient Roman Empire.

title: Blood Labs
description: This is a Rouge-like Shooter where you fight through procedurally generated rooms of mutants.

title: Archons of Doom
description: Play as an Archon of Doom to conquer the entire universe in this fantasy horror strategy game.

title: Bouboum
description: Bouboum is a multiplayer bomber-hamster strategy game! Engage against other hamsters and various animals in explosive battles. Clear your way and your enemies in maze-like levels and be the last one to stay alive!

title: The Next Jianghu I
description: "The next Jianghu I" is a game that combines the jianghu, martial arts, collection, cultivation and war chess. You can experience the adventures and anecdotes in the Jianghu. Where do we not meet in life? Who are heroes? Next stop, Jianghu!

title: Schwerpunkt
description: Schwerpunkt is a World War 2 military simulation game. Take control of hundreds of units over a large frontline, making daring manoeuvres to push your enemy back. Fight in one of the scenarios given or make your own in the map maker.

title: The Owl Quest
description: The Owl Quest is an unpretentious little pixel art point'n click adventure game that aims to immerse the player in the atmosphere of the first adventure games of the 80s and 90s.

title: Dancing In the Moonlight
description: "Dancing Under the Moon" is a single-player only 3d bullet-running action game. Enjoy the sensation of being overwhelmed by a barrage of bullets in 3d space.

title: Pnevmo-Capsula: Domiki
description:
The action of the steampunk game "Pnevmo-Capsula: Domiki" takes place in Russia of the 70s.

The game opens the door to the history of parallel Russian reality, where society and technologies developed along the path of cultivating harsh mechanics. All houses are connected by a system of tiny rails along which you have to move in the form of a steampunk tiny capsule.

Search and activation of the hidden mechanisms such as springs, telephones and various incandescent lamps, passing traps, portals, mechanical mail boxes and other quests will show you the way to the end of the level.

All the action takes place in the setting of the harsh communist future dominated by bulky analog electronics.

title: Gaggle Brains!
description: Gaggle Brains! is a short puzzle game with 16 levels and simple controls. Steer your crowd of procedurally animated, physics driven humans, past multiple hordes of zombies - try to get as many past the finish line as possible.

title: BlackChain
description: A classic single-player RTS set in a Solar System ruled by megacorporations. Journey from Mars all the way to Planet 9 and uncover the secrets of the BlackChain.

title: Marshall Mellow
description: Marshall Mellow is a game about jumping up blocks as they fall.

title: Uboat Commander
description: "U-boat Commander" is an upcoming strategy game in which players take a Wolfpack commander role in the Second World War. Their task is to plan, synchronize, and execute u-boat attacks on Allied convoys in the Atlantic Ocean.

title: Little Hats
description: Little Hats is an open-world survival game with RPG elements, in which you play as a Gnome. Set in a magical world, you will have to survive, build, and explore in order to discover the secrets of the forest and the many lands that lay beyond.

title: Mòlù Tiáosèbǎn
description: Survive seven days with a cursed painting. Rely on notes from past victims and manage to successfully paint her portrait. But be careful not to upset her, or you'll quickly find yourself dead! An assortment of terminal tableaus awaits you. Will you be the one to finally finish her?

title: Russian Prison Tattoo Simulator
description: Become a tattoo artist in Russian Prison. Get introduced to tattoo iconography and special meanings of Russian Prison tattoos

title: Fallen from the sky
description: Fallen from the sky - a casual game with adventure elements, executed in 2.5 D graphics, where you have to descend from heaven to earth. The game is attractive not for its visual component and gameplay variety, but for the philosophical thought underlying it.

title: Strike VR
description: A fast action arcade game revamped into Virtual Reality. Shoot with your weapon, dodge bullets with your body, deflect bullets with your swords, and launch missiles and ultimate skills!

title: A Comfortable Burden
description: A cute and colorful time management game yet intense! Discover the mental load as you play this otter couple taking care of their house and family in their daily life.

title: Shadow Lost
description: What dark and twisted things are happening in the strange town?

title: Dream Back
description: Dream back Dream back is an open-world sandbox development game with rich and colorful gameplay. In order to ensure absolute personalization, everyone is welcome to complain and feedback, and I will fix it as quickly as possible. Welcome to join the official QQ group: 619641228

title: Fury Knight
description: This game is a fantasy platformer presenting adventures of a little knight committed to get bad creatures out of the magic world with the help of a sword and magic.

title: One Pixel
description: 2D platform game with minimalist pixel art graphics, create platforms and shoot a lot to defeat an army with more than 1,000 monsters. The game was made for people who like a challenge and don't mind dying several times.

title: Hyforge
description: Hyforge is a "roguelike", first-person fantasy rpg; a self-proclaimed "Elder-Rogue." On your quest to find the Hyforge, a device capable of creating and destroying all life, you will encounter Majik, Mystery, and LOOT. Also death... PERMA-DEATH.

title: Cavebound
description: Cavebound is a fun survival co-op/single player game! In Cavebound, the goal is to keep an underground mine up and running while avoiding a deadly monster. You can play by yourself or with up to 3 other players.

title: FBI Agent Simulator
description: You are an FBI agent. Look for the clues, follow the leads, investigate, interview the suspects and find a culprit. The fate of the victims and their families lies in your hands – can you meet the challenge?

title: Street Massacre
description: Street gangs fight among themselves in the middle of the city at night. Whoever manages to live will see the light of day!

title: Box Cat Bash
description: Cars are falling from the sky? Time to get smashing, Box Cat!

title: Death Taxi 3000
description: Retro arcade racer inspired by the MS-DOS era

title: Relax Memory Game
description: Relax Memory Game-find a pair Game, more than 30 levels, with a choice of difficulty, a time limit that is added by guessing pairs and a limited number. The game develops your memory and attentiveness.

title: Geadows
description: Another bad dream? Another bad memory? Fight against your past, defeat hundreds of robots sent by GEA, the artificial intelligence that stole everything from you and condemn you to your present. Welcome to Geadows, a third person shooter roguelike. Do you accept the challenge?

title: Esper Uprising: Hearts of Crystal
description: Valterra's newly legalized esper hunts increase business opportunities for smugglers like yourself, but only if you compromise your morals and betray the espers in your crew first.

title: Fox's Holiday
description: Fox vacation is a lighthearted nostalgia game. In the game, the player arranges all the journey of the fox through the plan, and at the same time, we can find our lost childhood. 32 weeks to complete the content of the week. Let's have a good holiday!

title: HaberDashers
description: HaberDashers is a console-style arcade (kart) racer for the PC in which players control miniature humanoid inhabitants of an everyday home, racing past outsized household items and through rooms as they compete against human and AI opponents with both driving skills and item pick-ups.

title: I Want to Fly
description: This is the story of Evie Maine, a shy girl with a difficult past. Evie is just starting her first year of university away from home. At first she's worried about fitting in, but once she sees a glider flying high above, her priorities quickly change. My name is Evie, and I want to fly.

title: Gunjump Before Dinner
description: 2D precision platformer with tight and responsive controls. Gunjump your way through challenging obstacle course.

title: Plecos Keep
description: A 2D platformer where you can harpoon oceanic enemies, explore and keep the ocean free from chaos.

title: Escape the Underground
description: At the bottom of a massive underground dump, a sentient pile of sludge is born. After finding a discarded book that shows photographs of the surface, they decide to make the journey upward to see the outside world.

title: Conquest of Elysium 5
description: Conquest of Elysium 5 is a quick turn based fantasy strategy game with a touch of rogue-like. The game is full of depth, details and monsters. There are also a huge number of factions, each with its own unique gameplay and magic rituals.

title: Mojica
description: "Only the keyboard is used in this game!" Beat looming enemies with your typing skill! Switch lanes and defeat enemies by typing letters. This is an all-new typing game with strategy and a thrill.

title: Until Sunset
description: There are three things all wise men fear: the sea in storm, a night with no moon, and the anger of a gentle man.

title: Dungeons & Cocks
description: The plot of the game is dedicated to the life story of Matthew Delaney, an elderly Bon vivant who was forced to leave his country, after it had been captured. He reaches the shores of the New World, but the unknown land does not welcome old Delaney as warmly as he planned...

title: Cradle-18
description: You wake up on a deserted space station on the orbit of unknown planet. How did you come here? What happened with crew? What is happenning here? You have to find out. And also you have to survive here because the station is fraught with many dangers.

title: Mad Chess
description: Mermaids, Angels and Dragons join the classic game of Chess as 3 additional factions with their own units and abilities. Madness? No, this is Mad Chess!

title: Rekindle
description:
Single, alone, and just plain miserable is not how most people would feel on their birthday, but it’s the sad reality for you. Refusing to have the day be a complete waste, you decide it's worth at least getting a cake for yourself.

Why is it that once you have the cake in hand, fate makes you walk past three incredibly important figures from your past?

What could this even mean for you?

title: Chinese Empire
description: Chinese Empire is an economic city-building strategy taking place in the picturesque areas of China. Create your own new empire that will go down in history!

title: Mastermine
description: Mastermine is a 3D, minesweeper inspired puzzle game - solve complex boards over a 3D Rubik's Cube-esque map.

title: Glitch Escape
description: A Surreal Puzzle-Platformer Adventure Game.

title: Catch the Stars
description: CATch the Stars is a minimalist puzzle with a pleasant and original soundtrack. Click on the right star, solve the puzzles and form constellations with a beautiful and relaxing environment. No score, no timer and no pressure.

title: Partless Ron
description: Partless Ron is a 2d platformer with metroidvania elements, the player explores locations, looking for new improvements to pass levels that he could not pass before, solving riddles of intricate locations and looking for the right way out.

title: Askara
description: Askara is a rogue-like turn-based tactics game, you choose how long each run takes, from a half an hour, to a few days if you want to! Multiple layers of mechanics mesh together to ensure that every run will be unique. It is easy to pick up, but will take years to master.

title: Truants
description: Scott Bowers has been mysteriously contacted by a young girl, who claims she's being forcibly treated for "video game addiction." Can he save the kids trapped in the behavioral center, and find out why he's being targeted by the dark forces who run it? Inspired by true events.

title: No Light
description: The objective of this game is to scare you, you will not wait, you will run ... A Guard against five demons.

title: Life of A Yandere Simp
description: Life of a Yandere Simp is a simulation game inside a university where you, a simp, have to find out who is interested in your love interest and eliminate them.

title: The Island
description: O maior desafio em the island é sobreviver. Tudo quer que você morra - seja a vida selvagem da ilha ou outros habitantes,Faça o que for preciso para sobreviver.

title: Rogue Explorer
description: Pixel Art Hack & Slash Roguelike Action! Do you dare to discover what awaits you deep in the abyss? Explore randomly generated dungeons in a roguelike action experience. Hack and slash enemies, acquire loot, and obtain enhancements to your existing equipment. Start your exploration now!

title: Wulin Chess
description: This is an oriental fantasy game of turn-based strategy. On the basis of the traditional turn-based strategy game, it incorporates a more rational growth model, stronger role mechanisms, deeper strategic caps, and rich collection of growth elements.

title: Their Radiance
description: Their Radiance is an unconventional walking simulator about love.

title: Rocket Bots
description: Wreck your rivals with a rocket launcher in a fast-paced FPS

title: Dungeon of Eyden
description: Dungeon of Eyden is a hack & slash co-op game, with fun mechanics and simple, yet eye-catching graphics and an every time world it re-create itself.

title: CyberGrid: Tower defense
description: Tower defense is a Tower defense game containing HQ, Tower, and 3 building that generates resources. In order to build a building, you must have enough resources. Each building can generate different resources. You must protect the HQ from the Enemy

title: President's Sniper Shooting
description: President's car is being chased by militant's cars. You have limited time to shoot them all. You are the president's die-hard loyalist.

title: DotStrike
description: DotStrike is a 2D top-down shooter. The players are large dots with a tapered nose. Players are divided into two teams: red and blue. Fight both bots and real players on the local network or via the Internet!

title: Bloody Service
description: The conjoined twins were bullied and humiliated... Now justice will be served! BLOODY SERVICE is a dark, gory and violent coming-of-age slasher FMV Visual Novel with gruesome deaths and clever one-liners related to tennis. Game, set, machete!

title: Sun Warriors
description: SUN WARRIORS is a frantic, hardcore, cooperative, twin stick shooter. The Moon Goddess, Aysel, is invading our world with a horde of creatures from the dark. As a son of the Sun God Naol, use the power of light to blast all enemies and stop the corruption that is invading our land.

title: Maze Banquet
description: A nameless boy emerges from the darkness. His creator led him to the banquet with a letter: "Observe the guests and appoint one as the Maze King". Deprived of his voice, the boy heads to the Maze Banquet. He encounters the four creations at the entrance... from there a mysterious adventure unfolds!

title: Gravity Field
description: Gravity Field is a spatial-logic puzzle game with time inverted objects, with no top or bottom.

title: Roce's Journey
description: Roce's Journey is a game based on the Sokoban, with 20 different puzzles and 100 levels. Players need to understand the characteristics of each mechanism and interact to solve the puzzle.

title: Wonder Cave
description: The Wonder Cave. Inspired by tales of Aladdin, Ali Baba, and more, this magical adventure puts you on the trail of a certain magic lamp, taking you through a puzzling series of challenges in the process.

title: Eat'n Eaten
description: A tower defense but instead of towers you have a buzzing ecosystem of plants and creatures with needs : your organisms need to eat in order to evolve and survive! Try to maintain balance of the food chain until you annihilate the very last invader!

title: XpCade
description: Play virtual arcade machines, and program them using a new programming language. Go out explore, edit and play mission maps.

title: Pillow Simulator
description: Bored of sheep, flower and stone simulators? Do you want something really different? Meet the pillow simulator!

title: Puppy Adventure
description: Puppy Adventure - Top Down View game with role-playing elements and finding puzzles, you in the role of a knight clear the locations of opponents and move through the intricate forests of the kingdom in order to find all the pieces of the puzzle and put them together.

title: Seafarers
description: Set sail on your adventure to become the number one merchant in all the world! Trade, fight, or negotiate your way to the top in your own style!

title: Shattering Obsidian
description: An RPG inspired by the classics, and based upon a series of published stories. A deep, character-driven adventure, in a Fantasy-Steampunk world of betrayal and intrigue.

title: Walthros: Renewal
description: Make some friends, eat some burgers, and unearth terrible secrets from the depths of space.

title: Waves of Death
description: Following the tragic mistake of military scientists, a new generation of a viral compound has spread through the city allowing the dead to come back to life... All the dead, but also the bloodthirsty Bosses. Jake has to cross the city to save his loved-ones.The countdown begins!

title: Robin Hood: Hail to the King
description: Welcome to Robin Hood's third incredible adventure! From its comical campaign to its hilarious bonus chapter, you will love guiding the legendary Robin Hood and his friends in this new time-management game.

title: Ricky Did Nothing Wrong
description: Have fun with little puzzles in this Point & Click game! But be careful with the choices you make...

title: Brushlings Pale Moon
description: Brushlings is built for PC and projected to be on the Nintendo Switch. You play as Gaia in a solo campaign to restore color to the world before it's lost for good. Use a variety of elemental abilities to solve puzzles and defeat enemies to save the world from becoming colorless forever.

title: Kor
description: Explore an alien world, meet a variety of eccentric characters, unveil an unconventional story, and experience a combat system that blends turn-based strategy with skillful combo execution in this classically-inspired retro RPG adventure!

title: The Secret Blue Forest
description: A relaxing wordless low poly adventure. You play as an Ice Sorcerer whose magic has a connection to the Ice forest, you're the only one who doesn't seem to be warped by the Ice forests magic, this allows you to create slippery ice, shoot ice shards, double jump and move boxes at range.

title: Zombie Camping
description: Zombie Camping is a third person shooter based in a forest camping where zombies are coming in waves trying to kill you.

title: Plague Breaker
description: Plague Breaker is a retro rogue-lite platformer with heavy RPG elements. Pick your class, create unique characters by multiclassing or create your own class with the class creator, all while exploring a procedurally generated castle filled with undead monsters and corrupted plague doctors.

title: Retexo Mori
description: Retexo Mori is a Pac-Man-like game in first person, with bullet hell elements and an aesthetic that clashes early 90's FPS pixel-art with vaporwave.

title: Help me please
description: You can't negotiate with zombies, you can't bribe or promise something in return, they will slowly but surely follow you wherever you go to destroy you. It's impossible to hide from zombies, they always sense where you're hiding. The only way to escape is to destroy them first.

title: Maritime Calling
description: Maritime Calling is a narrative-driven RPG in which you lead a daring expedition into the New World. Survive the life at sea, assign sailors to various jobs, fight naval battles, lead island expeditions and break the Empire's hold over the New World in an enchanting seafaring adventure.

title: Carrot Heart
description: The game is a co-op rogue-like with a variety of enemies that require wise choice of weapons and different tactical solutions.

title: Spellbound : The Magic Within
description: Spellbound: The Magic Within is a choose your own adventure style visual novel. Jump into a world of Magic, Witchcraft and Mystery as a magician in training. Interact with a host of unusual characters. Choose from multiple schools of magic, bond with your tutor, and maybe even save the world.

title: Oplitak
description: Oplitak is a game that combines various game mechanics such as 2D platforms and 2D shooters. The combination of cartoon-style graphics, dynamic gameplay and easter eggs make the game attractive to both young and old school gamers.

title: Kosmonavtes: Escape Reality
description: A Room Escape and puzzle / adventure game! Help Vala fulfil her dream and become an astronaut!

title: OverDrift Festival
description: Become the star on festival of car culture and sports. Drift, sprint and circuit racing. Huge game world, iconic tracks. Unique collection of cars. Wide range of tuning and styling options. Accurate physics: a sense of speed and lateral g-forces.

title: Pit of Ascension
description: Jump, dodge, and shoot your way through a series of bosses to become the champion of the pit in this bossfight roguelike!

title: Yuha's Nightmares
description: This is a simulation game about the nightmares that our main character Yuha suffers from. You will explore the surrealistic world that is full of unexpected events. The deeper part of Yuha's consciousness is depicted through the flip side of the 3D world.

title: Shank the Cop
description: A multiplayer mind game. Cops have to decide who is a threat and who is not. Decide who is your opponent and shoot them down, or play as the criminal and shank the cop!

title: Cytoclash
description: Cytoclash is an action-packed lightgun-style shooter that calls upon you as Earth's best hope against a monstrous alien invasion! Suit-up and blast your way through hordes of enemies and massive bosses in the debut release from Setrino Software!

title: Gǔlóng Chuánshuō
description: 一款电脑、安卓、苹果iOS三端互通的武侠回合制网络游戏。

title: Dropshipping Simulator
description: Dropshipping Simulator, sell to customers by buying products cheaply! Earn money by making smart cyrptocoin investments! Decorate your house any way you want! and eat a good meal!

title: Pour There
description: Logic game (puzzle) - collect bonuses in the form of yellow ducks. Use bombs and rockets to make passages. You will need to think about it.

title: Alexei Run
description: AlexeiRun - Runner, where you have to go around many obstacles, running away from HIM. Collect discs and buy upgrades to go all the way, unlocking new levels and difficulties. After this game, your reaction and manual dexterity will increase dramatically.

title: Star Aegis
description: Star Aegis is an old school, wave-based arcade shmup without shooting. Choose which side of the ship to protect with your shields and reflect the enemies bullets back at them or just ram them down with your shield.

title: Jump Kingdom
description: You are a "no power" protagonist, you can only avoid the enemy, including BOSS battles, the game has a rich BGM.

title: Quarantine Run
description: Quarantine Run is an cinematic story based, endless runner game with multiplayer, where you try to survive the pandemic by running and keeping up to date with the interesting news via Pandemi Radio. The multiplayer game mode is currently a beta, your support will help in the completion of this Game.

title: No Sushi, No Life
description: You’ve arrived at a robot sushi bar with one goal in mind… To eat all the sushi you can. Grab all the sushi coming your way and stuff them in your mouth! Test your reflexes as more and more plates of sushi rush toward you!

title: GOC Royale
description: GOC Royale is a massively multiplayer card game that takes you to randomly generated islands to take part in battles to the death.

title: Cards & Crystals
description: Match3 meets Trading Card Game! Collect cards, level up your heroes, and build decks to defeat your foes in this fast-paced puzzle/strategy game.

title: Yolo Space Hacker
